3f1a57de6fc5.en: Part forty-two. Machines in the market: what happens when the traders are programs that learn, and the market is made of them. Artificial markets, herding, simulators, learning market makers, algorithms that collude without speaking, and crowds that share one model.
3f1a57de6fc5.zh: 第42部分。市场中的机器：当交易者是会学习的程序、市场本身由它们组成时，会发生什么。人工市场、羊群效应、模拟器、会学习的做市商、不用交流就能合谋的算法，以及共用一个模型的人群。

e3eb0d99d5ea.en: Four findings, with their scope. <bookmark mark='a'/> Pricing learners reach a profit index of 81 percent between continuous Nash and monopoly benchmarks; a selected fixed-point subset retaliates after forced undercuts. <bookmark mark='b'/> Reusing another rule's fills gives a wider quote score of 445, against 129 in interactive simulated trading. <bookmark mark='c'/> With independent unit-variance signal components, common weight point two explains 86 percent of a hundred traders' aggregate flow variance. <bookmark mark='d'/> Kirman's specified imitation chain has an exact stationary law. These are model results, not universal market estimates.
e3eb0d99d5ea.zh: 四项发现及其适用范围。<bookmark mark='a'/>定价学习者的利润插值指数为连续纳什与垄断基准差距的81%。选定的固定点子样本在被迫降价后出现报复。<bookmark mark='b'/>沿用另一规则的成交记录，宽报价的得分为445；交互式模拟交易只有129。<bookmark mark='c'/>若信号分量相互独立且方差为一，共同权重点二可以解释一百名交易者总订单流方差的86%。<bookmark mark='d'/>柯曼的特定模仿链有精确平稳分布。这些是模型结果，不是普遍的市场估计。

b0df85455e87.en: The desk question for this part, answered in Chapter six. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two algorithms that never communicate <bookmark mark='b'/> end up quoting wide spreads. <bookmark mark='c'/> Is that collusion? Hold your answer; the economist's and the lawyer's differ.
b0df85455e87.zh: 这一部分的交易台问题，在第6章回答。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个从不交流的算法，<bookmark mark='b'/>最终都报出很宽的价差。<bookmark mark='c'/>这算合谋吗？先记下你的答案；经济学家和律师的回答不同。

059976bc083f.en: Why it matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> Automated trading is important in many markets, but automation and adaptive learning are different categories; their shares depend on venue, period and definition. <bookmark mark='b'/> Interacting algorithms can produce collective behaviour that an isolated test misses. <bookmark mark='c'/> The House's proposed research standard therefore includes alternative opponents and copies of a successful policy. Such scenarios test mechanisms without claiming they predict deployment outcomes.
059976bc083f.zh: 为什么值得研究。<bookmark mark='a'/>自动交易在许多市场十分重要，但自动化与自适应学习是不同类别；占比取决于场所、时期和定义。<bookmark mark='b'/>算法交互可能产生单独测试看不到的集体行为。<bookmark mark='c'/>因此，本系列公司的研究标准建议测试不同对手，以及成功策略的复制品。这些情景检验机制，不意味着能预测实际部署结果。

2ece772adfd2.en: And what this part is not. <bookmark mark='a'/> No agent here is a recommendation, and none traded real money. <bookmark mark='b'/> The House runs no language model as a trader; Chapter five says why, and what a fair test would need. <bookmark mark='c'/> Every learned result comes from the House's own simulators, with fixed seeds.
2ece772adfd2.zh: 以及这一部分不是什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里没有一个智能体是投资建议，也没有一个用真钱交易过。<bookmark mark='b'/>本系列公司在这一部分没有运行任何作为交易者的语言模型；第5章解释原因，以及公平的检验需要什么。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个学习得到的结果都来自本系列公司自己的模拟器，随机种子固定。

5df8ed014c7b.en: Where this sits. Act seven, the system. Part forty measured risk and Part forty-one followed it into crises. This part puts machines into the market and watches what they do to it, and to each other. Part forty-three, the last, asks whether anyone beats the market at all.
5df8ed014c7b.zh: 这一部分的位置。第七幕，体系。第40部分度量风险，第41部分把它带进危机。这一部分把机器放进市场，观察它们对市场、对彼此做了什么。最后的第43部分追问：到底有没有人能战胜市场。

f09349fde131.en: Thirty years. Alan Kirman's ants; zero-intelligence traders; the Santa Fe artificial market; Lux and Marchesi. <bookmark mark='a'/> Reinforcement learning for execution; the flash crash; Knight Capital; Moore's law against Murphy's. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then Calvano's colluding learners and the ABIDES simulator, the first papers on AI and systemic risk, and the supervisors' reports of twenty twenty-four.
f09349fde131.zh: 三十年。艾伦·柯曼的蚂蚁；零智能交易者；圣塔菲人工市场；卢克斯和马尔凯西。<bookmark mark='a'/>用于执行的强化学习；闪电崩盘；骑士资本；摩尔定律对墨菲定律。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后是卡尔瓦诺会合谋的学习者和ABIDES模拟器，最早关于人工智能与系统性风险的论文，以及二〇二四年监管机构的报告。

17f23418adbf.en: The plan: artificial markets and herding; simulators; a learning market maker; language models as traders; algorithmic collusion, reproduced; crowds that share a model; what supervisors worry about; and the theorem that says when collusion can last.
17f23418adbf.zh: 计划：人工市场与羊群效应；模拟器；会学习的做市商；作为交易者的语言模型；复现算法合谋；共用一个模型的人群；监管机构担心什么；以及说明合谋何时能够持续的定理。

330e0f94cfdc.en: In the House, the research desk and the market makers bring their learning agents to compliance, which asks a question none of them was trained to answer: what happens to the market when they succeed?
330e0f94cfdc.zh: 在本系列公司里，研究部门和做市商把它们的学习型智能体带到合规部门面前，合规部门提出一个它们都没被训练来回答的问题：当它们成功时，市场会怎样？

76d3e2d35e40.en: Pause and predict. A market of traders following simple rules: some expect prices to revert to value, some chase trends. Can it produce the real market's fat tails and clustered volatility? And if so, what ingredient would it need?
76d3e2d35e40.zh: 暂停并预测。一个由遵循简单规则的交易者组成的市场：有人认为价格会回归价值，有人追逐趋势。它能产生真实市场的肥尾和波动率聚集吗？如果能，它需要什么成分？

4528aa9f3a6c.en: Chapter one, and a qualified answer to the pause: this chosen switching-agent model generates clustered volatility and heavier tails than its Gaussian comparator. That shows one possible mechanism. It does not prove that imitation is necessary, that fixed-rule markets must have thin tails, or that a matching simulation identifies the real market. We will compare its misses as well as its successes.
4528aa9f3a6c.zh: 第一章。暂停问题的答案是：在特定模型中可以。简单的基本面和趋势规则，通过相互作用，能够产生厚尾与波动聚集。但一种模拟机制的存在，不证明它是唯一或必要的解释，也不证明随机交易者在任何制度下都只能产生薄尾。我们先区分模型生成的事实、历史数据中的事实，以及两者之间尚未建立的因果联系。

f2e26f7957dd.en: The Santa Fe artificial market. <bookmark mark='a'/> Arthur, Holland, LeBaron, Palmer and Tayler gave agents forecasting rules that were selected and recombined. <bookmark mark='b'/> Their reported slow- and fast-learning regimes differed: prices could resemble a rational-expectations benchmark or show technical trading and clustered volatility. These are model-specific results, not a universal convergence theorem. <bookmark mark='c'/> Adaptive interaction offers a possible explanation, rather than a proof that real investors use these rules.
f2e26f7957dd.zh: 圣塔菲人工市场。<bookmark mark='a'/>阿瑟、霍兰德、勒巴伦、帕尔默和泰勒让智能体的预测规则经过选择与重组。<bookmark mark='b'/>论文报告的慢学习与快学习情景不同：价格可能接近理性预期基准，也可能出现技术交易和波动聚集。这是模型特定的结果，不是普遍收敛定理。<bookmark mark='c'/>自适应交互提供一种可能解释，而不是证明真实投资者采用这些规则。

63e49066d6e4.en: A smaller Franke-Westerhoff-type illustration in the House's module. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fundamentalists trade toward a fixed log fundamental value of zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> Chartists extrapolate the last move and have noisier orders. <bookmark mark='c'/> Net demand moves the log price. <bookmark mark='d'/> Switching attractiveness depends on the population imbalance and squared mispricing, with probabilities clipped at one. This implementation has no separate recent-profit state; the performance-based mechanism comes later in Brock and Hommes.
63e49066d6e4.zh: 本系列模块中的一个小型弗兰克—韦斯特霍夫类型示例。<bookmark mark='a'/>基本面交易者向固定为零的对数基本价值交易。<bookmark mark='b'/>图表交易者外推上次变动，其订单噪声更大。<bookmark mark='c'/>净需求推动对数价格。<bookmark mark='d'/>切换吸引力取决于群体失衡与价格偏离平方，概率在一处截断。这个实现没有单独的近期利润状态；绩效机制会在后面的布洛克—霍姆斯模型介绍。

7674603ba6c3.en: Two thousand simulated days. <bookmark mark='a'/> The returns come in bursts: calm stretches, then violent ones. <bookmark mark='b'/> And underneath, the chartists' share. When herding tips the crowd into chartism, their noisier, trend-chasing orders dominate, and volatility rises; when a large mispricing pulls them back to fundamentals, it falls. Volatility here has a cause you can see: who is trading.
7674603ba6c3.zh: 两千个模拟交易日。<bookmark mark='a'/>收益成串出现：平静的时段，然后是剧烈的时段。<bookmark mark='b'/>在它下面是图表交易者的份额。当羊群效应把人群推向图表交易，他们噪声更大、追逐趋势的订单占据主导，波动率上升；当巨大的定价偏离把他们拉回基本面，波动率下降。这里的波动率有一个看得见的原因：谁在交易。

cc39d146ad3a.en: Side by side, standardized and displayed on the same scale. <bookmark mark='a'/> The last two thousand research-window US market observations through December twenty twenty; March twenty twenty is near the end. <bookmark mark='b'/> A chosen two-thousand-day segment of the agent simulation also shows bursts. A visual resemblance is descriptive, not a held-out validation or evidence of a unique mechanism.
cc39d146ad3a.zh: 两条路径均标准化，并以相同尺度显示。<bookmark mark='a'/>截至二〇二〇年十二月，美国研究窗口最后两千个观测，三月波动位于末尾附近。<bookmark mark='b'/>选定的两千日智能体片段也有波动簇。图像相似只是描述，不是样本外验证，也不证明唯一机制。

e912e82a98c6.en: The descriptive statistics. <bookmark mark='a'/> Sample excess kurtosis is 16.7 for the research-window US market and 5.0 for this agent simulation; a Gaussian has population excess kurtosis zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> Hill estimates summarize a selected upper tail and do not prove an exact power law. <bookmark mark='c'/> Small linear return autocorrelations do not establish full unpredictability or efficiency. <bookmark mark='d'/> At lag twenty the absolute-return autocorrelation is 0.23 in the data and 0.23 here. These are descriptive comparisons, without a new fit or causal identification.
e912e82a98c6.zh: 描述统计。<bookmark mark='a'/>研究窗口美国市场的样本超额峰度为16.7，智能体模拟为5.0；高斯分布的总体超额峰度为零。<bookmark mark='b'/>希尔估计描述选定上尾，不能证明精确幂律。<bookmark mark='c'/>较小的线性收益自相关不等于完全不可预测或市场有效。<bookmark mark='d'/>二十阶绝对收益自相关，数据为0.23，模拟为0.23。这些只是描述比较，没有新拟合或因果识别。

6abde71e047b.en: Absolute-return autocorrelations across horizons. <bookmark mark='a'/> These research-window US estimates show persistent dependence. <bookmark mark='b'/> The chosen agent simulation also shows persistence; the group share is a state variable that can move slowly. Matching this feature does not identify the real market's cause. <bookmark mark='c'/> Independent Gaussian draws have zero population autocorrelation, while finite-sample estimates fluctuate. Part seven used GARCH to describe such persistence.
6abde71e047b.zh: 不同滞后的绝对收益自相关。<bookmark mark='a'/>美国研究窗口估计显示持续依赖。<bookmark mark='b'/>选定智能体模拟也有持续性，群体份额是可能缓慢变化的状态变量。匹配这一特征不识别真实市场成因。<bookmark mark='c'/>独立高斯抽样的总体自相关为零，有限样本估计却会波动。第七部分用GARCH描述这种持续性。

8aef4439bde2.en: The original simulated-moments grid uses eighty-one parameter pairs and a fixed simulation seed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its loss matches two research-window moments, scaled by their target values. <bookmark mark='b'/> The best tested cell gives kurtosis 7.1 versus 16.7, and lag-twenty dependence 0.25 versus 0.23. This boundary optimum is not a continuous optimum or an unseen forecast. <bookmark mark='c'/> Across this chosen grid the loss changes 2.8-fold overall, but by at most 17 percent along the extrapolation direction at fixed noise. Weak sensitivity here suggests limited parameter information; it is not a general identification theorem. No new tuning is performed.
8aef4439bde2.zh: 原始模拟矩网格包含八十一个参数组合，使用固定模拟种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>损失匹配研究窗口的两个矩，分别按目标值缩放。<bookmark mark='b'/>最佳测试格点的峰度为7.1，目标16.7；二十阶依赖为0.25，目标0.23。边界最优格点不是连续参数最优解，也不是未见数据预测。<bookmark mark='c'/>整个网格的损失变化2.8倍，但固定噪声、沿外推方向最多变化17%。这里的弱敏感性提示参数信息有限，不是一般识别定理。本次没有重新调参。

8dbadc478c3c.en: The mechanism within this simulation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Conditional on the full current state and independent order shocks, the next log-return innovation variance is determined by the squared group shares and their noise scales. Conditioning only on the share can leave extra variation from other state variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> Feedback can make the share persistent. <bookmark mark='c'/> This motivates the structural stochastic-volatility interpretation; it does not identify observed market volatility from the plot alone.
8dbadc478c3c.zh: 模拟内部的机制。<bookmark mark='a'/>给定完整当前状态，并假定订单冲击独立，下一期对数收益创新的方差由群体份额平方与噪声尺度决定。若只给定图表交易者份额，其他状态变量仍可能带来额外变化。<bookmark mark='b'/>反馈能够使份额具有持续性。<bookmark mark='c'/>这启发结构性随机波动解释，却不能从图中识别真实市场波动的成因。

6708e252ec37.en: The deterministic cousin, from William Brock and Cars Hommes. <bookmark mark='a'/> Traders choose among forecasting rules with logit probabilities, <bookmark mark='b'/> weighted by each rule's recent profit, so fashions follow performance. <bookmark mark='c'/> As the intensity of choice rises, the steady state at the fundamental value loses stability, first to cycles, then to chaos. They called it a rational route to randomness: no noise needed, only switching toward what worked.
6708e252ec37.zh: 它的确定性表亲，来自威廉·布洛克和卡斯·霍姆斯。<bookmark mark='a'/>交易者以logit概率在预测规则之间选择，<bookmark mark='b'/>权重是每条规则最近的利润，所以潮流追随业绩。<bookmark mark='c'/>随着选择强度上升，位于基本面价值的稳态失去稳定，先变成周期，再变成混沌。他们称之为通往随机性的理性之路：不需要噪声，只需要向有效的规则切换。

74f3f14854da.en: An institutional comparison. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gode and Sunder reported high allocative efficiency for budget-constrained random traders in specified double auctions. It is not guaranteed by arbitrary random trading. <bookmark mark='b'/> Farmer and coauthors studied what selected order-book statistics can follow from a random-flow model. <bookmark mark='c'/> Market rules and adaptive behavior can both matter. These examples do not show that imitation is the only way to produce fat tails or clustering.
74f3f14854da.zh: 一个制度比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>戈德与桑德报告，预算约束下的随机交易者在指定双向拍卖中有较高配置效率，但任意随机交易不保证这一点。<bookmark mark='b'/>法默等人研究了哪些特定订单簿统计可由随机订单流模型产生。<bookmark mark='c'/>市场规则与适应行为都可能重要。这些例子不证明模仿是产生厚尾或波动聚集的唯一方式。

0e1fb297a790.en: Pause and predict. A hundred agents each sometimes switch view on their own, and sometimes copy whoever they happen to meet. If copying is far more common than switching alone, where does the crowd spend its time: evenly split, or somewhere else?
0e1fb297a790.zh: 暂停并预测。一百个智能体，每个有时自己改变看法，有时模仿碰巧遇到的人。如果模仿远比独自改变常见，人群会把时间花在哪里：平分两边，还是别处？

ec7bdbb90624.en: Chapter two, and the answer to the pause: at the extremes. When copying dominates, the crowd spends most of its time almost unanimous, one way or the other, and swings between the two from time to time. It is evenly split only rarely. With a hundred agents, as here, it is unanimous 38 percent of the time.
ec7bdbb90624.zh: 第2章，以及暂停问题的答案：在两端。当模仿占主导时，人群大部分时间几乎一致，偏向这一边或那一边，并不时在两者之间摇摆。它很少平分。像这里一样有一百个智能体时，它有38%的时间完全一致。

e9fe357945ff.en: Kirman's ant-model illustration, using the exact chain in this module. <bookmark mark='a'/> One agent is selected at each step. <bookmark mark='b'/> Spontaneous switching contributes epsilon. <bookmark mark='c'/> Imitation contributes an additional rate proportional to the number holding the opposite view: it is added, not multiplied by one minus epsilon. The displayed up and down probabilities must define a valid chain. <bookmark mark='d'/> The number holding A moves by at most one, giving a birth-and-death chain.
e9fe357945ff.zh: 柯曼的蚂蚁模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>每一步随机选择一名智能体。<bookmark mark='b'/>切换概率包含自发改变意见的加性项。<bookmark mark='c'/>再加上与另一观点人数成比例的模仿项；不是先以某概率独立切换，否则才复制。<bookmark mark='d'/>持观点甲的人数构成有限生灭链。参数必须使这些概率有效。

667fc166de98.en: A hundred agents. <bookmark mark='a'/> With copying far more common than independent switching, the share sits near zero or one, and lurches across. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ten times more independent switching, and the same crowd hovers around a half. The agents are identical; only the balance between thinking alone and copying has changed.
667fc166de98.zh: 一百个智能体。<bookmark mark='a'/>当模仿远比独立切换常见时，份额停留在零或一附近，并突然跳到另一端。<bookmark mark='b'/>独立切换多十倍，同一群人就在一半附近徘徊。智能体完全相同；变化的只是独立思考与模仿之间的平衡。

42c8d6c30ba4.en: The exact finite-population law. <bookmark mark='a'/> For positive epsilon, delta below one, N above one and valid transition probabilities, the stationary distribution is beta-binomial with alpha equal to epsilon times N minus one divided by one minus delta. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Beta limit holds when alpha stays fixed as N grows, so epsilon scales inversely with N minus one. Alpha below one gives a U-shaped limiting density; above one gives a central hump. Keeping epsilon fixed is a different asymptotic regime.
42c8d6c30ba4.zh: 精确有限群体分布。<bookmark mark='a'/>自发切换为正、德尔塔小于一、人数大于一且转移概率有效时，平稳分布为贝塔二项；阿尔法等于自发切换率乘人数减一，再除以一减德尔塔。<bookmark mark='b'/>人数增加时保持阿尔法固定，才有贝塔极限，因此自发切换率按人数减一的倒数缩放。阿尔法小于一时极限密度呈U形，大于一时中间隆起。固定自发切换率属于另一种渐近情景。

967fee6d5e14.en: The proof is four lines. <bookmark mark='a'/> A birth-and-death chain is reversible, so detailed balance fixes its stationary law one step at a time. <bookmark mark='b'/> The chance of moving up: pick an agent holding B, then it converts on its own or meets one of the k holding A. Factor out one minus delta over N minus one, and epsilon becomes alpha. <bookmark mark='c'/> The chance of moving down, the same way. <bookmark mark='d'/> The factors cancel, and what is left is exactly the ratio of successive beta-binomial probabilities.
967fee6d5e14.zh: 证明只有四行。<bookmark mark='a'/>生灭链是可逆的，所以细致平衡一步一步确定它的平稳分布。<bookmark mark='b'/>上升的概率：选中一个持B观点的智能体，然后它自己转变，或者遇到k个持A观点者之一。提出一减delta除以N减一这个因子，epsilon就变成alpha。<bookmark mark='c'/>下降的概率，同理。<bookmark mark='d'/>因子相消，剩下的恰好是贝塔二项分布相邻概率之比。

461aa3aea535.en: Two forty-million-step runs, after the stated burn-in, are compared with their exact stationary probabilities. <bookmark mark='a'/> The low-switching case puts more mass near the extremes. <bookmark mark='b'/> The higher-switching chain is centrally concentrated, but still contains imitation and is not a population of independent agents. <bookmark mark='c'/> Total-variation differences are 0.009 and 0.005; the two exact finite-state formulas agree to numerical precision. A single long run is a check, not a proof of sampling error bounds.
461aa3aea535.zh: 两次四千万步运行，在指定预热后与精确平稳概率比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>低自发切换情景把更多质量放在极端。<bookmark mark='b'/>高切换情景集中在中间，但仍含模仿，并不是相互独立的智能体。<bookmark mark='c'/>总变差距离为0.009和0.005；两个有限状态精确公式在数值精度内一致。一次长模拟是检验，不是采样误差界的证明。

7461ea9a57a2.en: The recursion gives an exact mean first-passage time for this specified finite chain. <bookmark mark='a'/> The mean time to step down from k satisfies the displayed recursion from the top state. <bookmark mark='b'/> Summing from eleven through ninety gives passage from exactly ninety to exactly ten. <bookmark mark='c'/> The low-switching value is 52,945 steps, versus 52,128 in the sampled simulation. <bookmark mark='d'/> The higher-switching values are 20,632 and 21,087. Simulation is inspected only every ten steps, starts when the sampled state is at least ninety and ends at at most ten. It includes sampling delay and possible overshoot, so it is not an exact observation of the theoretical passage.
7461ea9a57a2.zh: 递推给出这个有限链的精确平均首次通过时间。<bookmark mark='a'/>从人数k向下走一步的平均时间，从最高状态按所示公式递推。<bookmark mark='b'/>十一到九十的和给出从恰好九十到恰好十的通过时间。<bookmark mark='c'/>低切换理论为52945步，采样模拟为52128步。<bookmark mark='d'/>高切换分别为20632与21087步。模拟每十步检查，从采样人数至少九十开始，到不超过十结束，包含检查延迟与越界，因此不是理论精确通过时间的相同观测。

26bfd254deb5.en: Keep alpha fixed at nought point two, adjusting spontaneous switching as population size changes. <bookmark mark='a'/> The exact model probability of unanimity is 38 percent at a hundred agents, 24 at a thousand, and 15 at ten thousand. <bookmark mark='b'/> It falls at the stated power rate. These stationary probabilities concern this chain, not how long real investors agree or a universal empirical scaling law.
26bfd254deb5.zh: 保持阿尔法为点二，随群体人数调整自发切换。<bookmark mark='a'/>精确完全一致概率，一百人时为38%，一千人为24%，一万人为15%。<bookmark mark='b'/>它按给定幂次渐近下降。这是该链的平稳概率，不是真实投资者一致多久的度量，也不是普遍经验尺度律。

0f87a3836bcf.en: The chosen illustrative price adds a sentiment premium to fundamental noise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Low spontaneous switching can create bursts when sentiment changes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compare the higher-switching case, which still has imitation. <bookmark mark='c'/> Lag-five absolute-return dependence is 0.06 versus 0.02; excess kurtosis is 0.5 versus 0.1. These chosen simulations show different strengths and misses. They do not prove imitation necessary for observed market tails or identify a unique empirical mechanism.
0f87a3836bcf.zh: 这个示例价格在基本面噪声上加情绪溢价。<bookmark mark='a'/>低自发切换可在情绪改变时产生波动簇。<bookmark mark='b'/>较高切换情景仍然含模仿。<bookmark mark='c'/>五阶绝对收益依赖分别为0.06与0.02，超额峰度为0.5与0.1。选定模拟各有匹配与偏差，不证明模仿是市场厚尾的必要条件，也不识别唯一经验机制。

b62fa82d20ce.en: Herding in a market. <bookmark mark='a'/> Thomas Lux and Michele Marchesi built chartists, divided into optimists and pessimists who herd, alongside fundamentalists, all switching by contagion and by profits. <bookmark mark='b'/> It produced fat tails and clustered volatility as bursts of chartist dominance, while prices still tracked fundamentals on average. <bookmark mark='c'/> And Simone Alfarano, Lux and Friedrich Wagner put Kirman's process inside a market model simple enough to estimate, with this chapter's Beta law for sentiment.
b62fa82d20ce.zh: 市场中的羊群效应。<bookmark mark='a'/>托马斯·卢克斯和米凯莱·马尔凯西构建了分成乐观者和悲观者、彼此跟风的图表交易者，以及基本面交易者，所有人通过传染和利润来切换。<bookmark mark='b'/>它产生了肥尾和波动率聚集，表现为图表交易者阶段性主导，而价格平均仍跟随基本面。<bookmark mark='c'/>西蒙娜·阿尔法拉诺、卢克斯和弗里德里希·瓦格纳把柯曼过程放进一个简单到可以估计的市场模型里，情绪服从本章的贝塔分布。

af226cb201fe.en: In real markets. <bookmark mark='a'/> Josef Lakonishok, Andrei Shleifer and Robert Vishny measured whether more pension funds trade a stock in the same direction than chance would give: a little, mostly in small stocks. <bookmark mark='b'/> And herding can be rational: when others' actions carry information, copying them is sensible, and an information cascade can still be wrong. <bookmark mark='c'/> Machines trained on the same data, or calling the same model, copy each other without ever meeting. That is Chapter seven.
af226cb201fe.zh: 在真实市场中。<bookmark mark='a'/>约瑟夫·拉孔尼肖克、安德烈·施莱弗和罗伯特·维什尼测量了同向交易一只股票的养老基金是否比偶然情况下更多：多一点，主要在小盘股。<bookmark mark='b'/>羊群效应也可以是理性的：当别人的行动包含信息时，模仿是明智的，而信息瀑布仍可能是错的。<bookmark mark='c'/>用相同数据训练、或调用同一个模型的机器，不用见面就彼此模仿。那是第7章。

2ed51e6403bd.en: A specific information-cascade model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two equally likely states, conditionally independent binary signals correct with probability point seven, and sequential observation of actions rather than signals. Before a cascade, an exact posterior tie follows the private signal. <bookmark mark='b'/> When revealed evidence leads by two, one private signal cannot overturn it; later choices reveal no new information. <bookmark mark='c'/> Disagreeing signal pairs cancel; the first agreeing pair has correct-to-wrong odds p squared to q squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> The infinite-horizon wrong-cascade probability is 15.5 percent. The finite forty-agent simulation reports 15.7. This conclusion depends on the information and tie-breaking rules; copying in general need not obey it.
2ed51e6403bd.zh: 一个特定的信息瀑布模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>两种状态先验相同；二元私有信号在给定状态下独立，正确率点七；参与者依次观察行动而非信号。瀑布发生前，后验恰好平局时遵循私有信号。<bookmark mark='b'/>已揭示证据领先两个时，一条私有信号无法逆转，后续行动不再揭示新信息。<bookmark mark='c'/>相反信号对抵消，首个相同信号对的正确与错误比为p平方比q平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>无限期错误瀑布概率为15.5%；四十名智能体的有限模拟为15.7%。结论依赖信息结构与平局规则，并非所有复制行为都遵循它。

298c0255eb81.en: Pause and predict. A simulated market matches the real one on every stylised fact. Is a strategy that works in it likely to work in the real market?
298c0255eb81.zh: 暂停并预测。一个模拟市场在每一个典型事实上都与真实市场吻合。在它里面有效的策略，在真实市场里可能有效吗？

64404eaf30b0.en: Chapter three, and the answer to the pause: not necessarily, and often not. Matching the stylised facts says the simulator reproduces how prices move when nobody new arrives. A strategy needs something else: how the market responds to its own orders, and how the other traders adapt to it. Neither is in the historical data the simulator was fitted to.
64404eaf30b0.zh: 第3章，以及暂停问题的答案：不一定，而且常常不会。吻合典型事实只说明模拟器重现了没有新人加入时价格如何变动。策略需要的是别的东西：市场如何对它自己的订单作出反应，以及其他交易者如何适应它。这两者都不在拟合模拟器所用的历史数据里。

c2d360c0b4c3.en: What a modern market simulator is, taking ABIDES as the example. <bookmark mark='a'/> An exchange with a limit order book. <bookmark mark='b'/> Background traders and the strategy being tested. <bookmark mark='c'/> Orders and fills travel as messages with latency. <bookmark mark='d'/> It produces a tape and agent profits. Comparing runs with and without a strategy gives a counterfactual within the specified model. It does not by itself identify the strategy's causal effect in a real exchange.
c2d360c0b4c3.zh: 现代市场模拟器，以ABIDES为例。<bookmark mark='a'/>交易所包含限价订单簿。<bookmark mark='b'/>背景交易者与待测试策略共同参与。<bookmark mark='c'/>订单和成交通知以带延迟的消息传递。<bookmark mark='d'/>模拟产生行情记录和智能体利润。比较有无某策略的运行，得到的是给定模型内部的反事实，不自动识别真实交易所里的因果效应。

e8754dfce85a.en: How to judge a simulator. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, stylised facts: tails, clustering, spreads and depth across relevant horizons. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, responses to interventions: order impact and its decay, including the approximate square-root regimes discussed in Part thirty-seven. They are empirical benchmarks, not universal laws. <bookmark mark='c'/> Vyetrenko and coauthors proposed both kinds of realism metrics. Matching unconditional statistics does not ensure realistic responses to a new strategy.
e8754dfce85a.zh: 如何评估模拟器。<bookmark mark='a'/>先看相关时间尺度上的典型事实：尾部、波动聚集、价差和深度。<bookmark mark='b'/>再看干预响应：订单冲击及其衰减，包括第三十七部分讨论的近似平方根区间。这些是经验基准，不是普遍定律。<bookmark mark='c'/>维特连科等人提出两类真实性指标。匹配无条件统计，不保证新策略引发的响应真实。

e2fdd00fa739.en: Fitting one to data. <bookmark mark='a'/> Simulated moments choose parameters to match selected statistics. <bookmark mark='b'/> Weights determine which discrepancies matter; matching them does not identify every behavioural mechanism. <bookmark mark='c'/> Event models or generative networks can also learn order-book dynamics. Their counterfactual validity under unfamiliar policies needs separate evidence; neither a close fit nor a behavioural story guarantees it.
e2fdd00fa739.zh: 如何拟合数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>模拟矩方法选择参数以匹配选定统计。<bookmark mark='b'/>权重决定哪些误差重要；匹配这些矩不等于识别每项行为机制。<bookmark mark='c'/>事件模型或生成网络也能学习订单簿动态。面对陌生策略时，其反事实有效性需要独立证据；拟合接近或行为故事都不能保证它。

b37bb18af7e6.en: So the gap between simulation and reality has three sources. <bookmark mark='a'/> Artefacts: a learner finds whatever pays in the simulator, including its simplifications. A noise trader that is too patient is free money. <bookmark mark='b'/> The counterfactual: history shows how the market moved without you, and how it would move with you is assumed, not measured. <bookmark mark='c'/> And adaptation: real competitors learn back, so a strategy that pays changes the population that made it pay.
b37bb18af7e6.zh: 所以模拟与现实之间的差距有三个来源。<bookmark mark='a'/>人为痕迹：学习者会找到模拟器里一切能赚钱的东西，包括它的简化。一个过于耐心的噪声交易者就是白送的钱。<bookmark mark='b'/>反事实：历史显示的是没有你时市场如何变动，而有你时它会如何变动是假设出来的，不是测量出来的。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及适应：真实的竞争者会反过来学习，所以一个赚钱的策略会改变让它赚钱的那群人。

61c9ccc2ef62.en: This is an old problem in economics. <bookmark mark='a'/> Lucas argued that estimated relations can change when policy changes because people respond. <bookmark mark='b'/> Agents with objectives let a researcher recompute behaviour under new rules, but their objectives, beliefs and adaptation still need justification. They do not automatically solve the identification problem. <bookmark mark='c'/> A historical example is the Bank of England model of bond funds and dealers used to examine fire-sale mechanisms under stress.
61c9ccc2ef62.zh: 这是经济学的老问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>卢卡斯指出，政策改变后人们会响应，估计关系也可能改变。<bookmark mark='b'/>带目标函数的智能体让研究者在新规则下重算行为，但其目标、信念和适应方式仍需依据，不能自动解决识别问题。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个历史例子是英格兰银行的债券基金和交易商模型，用来研究压力下的抛售机制。

e1fd303c15e6.en: The dealer simulator used here is deliberately small. <bookmark mark='a'/> A latent value moves by a tick; informed traders observe its current value, not its next innovation. <bookmark mark='b'/> They buy below that value or sell above it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Noise participation falls exponentially with quote distance. <bookmark mark='d'/> The maker chooses width and inventory skew. Its score is latent-value marked profit and loss less an inventory penalty, rather than cash profit alone. The value innovation occurs after the trading decision.
e1fd303c15e6.zh: 这里的交易商模拟刻意保持简小。<bookmark mark='a'/>潜在价值以一跳变动，知情者看到当前值，而非下一次创新。<bookmark mark='b'/>他们在低于价值时买入，高于价值时卖出。<bookmark mark='c'/>噪声交易参与率随报价距离指数下降。<bookmark mark='d'/>做市商选择报价宽度和库存偏斜。得分是按潜在价值计价的损益，减库存惩罚，不只是现金利润。价值创新发生在交易决策之后。

55bdb34bbaa0.en: What this simulator leaves out. <bookmark mark='a'/> There is one maker, no order book, queue or speed race. <bookmark mark='b'/> The other traders do not learn. <bookmark mark='c'/> The maker observes only inventory and last trade, so different hidden value gaps share an observation. Failures can reflect this partial observation, the learning method, or model assumptions. A small simulator makes these mechanisms easier to audit; it does not make every failure the learner's fault.
55bdb34bbaa0.zh: 模拟省略了什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>只有一个做市商，没有订单簿、排队或速度竞争。<bookmark mark='b'/>其他交易者不会学习。<bookmark mark='c'/>做市商只观察库存与上一笔交易，所以不同隐藏价值缺口对应同一个观测。失败可能来自部分可观测性、学习方法或模型假设。小模型更容易审计，不等于所有失败都是学习者的错。

f61bc0c3a18f.en: Pause and predict. A market maker learns its quotes by trial and error in a market where five percent of traders are informed. It is then deployed where thirty percent are. Does it lose money? And does it do worse than one trained in the harder market?
f61bc0c3a18f.zh: 暂停并预测。一个做市商在百分之五的交易者知情的市场里通过试错学习报价。然后它被部署到百分之三十的交易者知情的市场。它会亏钱吗？它会比在更难的市场里训练的做市商做得更差吗？

21eb99ee5450.en: Chapter four. In this fixed-seed experiment, the learner trained with five percent informed traders scores 89 per session in the thirty-percent market. The learner trained there scores 89; the best of eight tested fixed rules scores 113. These are risk-penalised scores from finite training and evaluation, not proof that training regime never matters or that a particular method is universally superior.
21eb99ee5450.zh: 第四章。在这个固定种子的实验中，以百分之五知情者训练的学习者，在百分之三十市场每场得分89。在那里训练的学习者得89，八条固定规则中表现最好的得113。这些是有限训练与评估的风险惩罚得分，不证明训练环境永远无关，也不证明某方法普遍更优。

ad5e2f703f61.en: Reinforcement learning in finance, so far in this series. <bookmark mark='a'/> Hedging: Part seventeen's deep hedging, learned on simulated paths. <bookmark mark='b'/> Execution: Part thirty-seven's queue executor. <bookmark mark='c'/> And market making and allocation: quotes or weights as actions, inventory or holdings as the state. Ben Hambly, Renyuan Xu and Huining Yang survey all four. Each needs an environment to learn in; here all training and scoring take place in a simulator.
ad5e2f703f61.zh: 强化学习在本系列金融问题中的应用。<bookmark mark='a'/>对冲：第十七部分在模拟路径上学习的深度对冲。<bookmark mark='b'/>执行：第三十七部分的队列执行器。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及做市和配置：动作是报价或权重，观测是库存或持仓。汉布利、徐仁远和杨慧宁综述了这四类问题。都需要学习环境；这里的训练与评分全部在模拟器中进行。

565d70d7b17a.en: The dealer's learning interface. <bookmark mark='a'/> Inventory and last-trade side give thirty-nine observations. They omit the hidden gap between the maker's mid and latent value, so this is partially observed rather than a fully observed Markov decision process. <bookmark mark='b'/> Actions choose a half-spread and inventory skew. <bookmark mark='c'/> Reward is latent-value marked profit and loss less a risk penalty. <bookmark mark='d'/> Tabular Q-learning runs for twenty-four thousand sessions with a constant step size, then greedy policies are scored on fresh sessions. Classical convergence guarantees do not follow from this setup.
565d70d7b17a.zh: 交易商的学习接口。<bookmark mark='a'/>库存与上一笔交易方向给出三十九种观测，遗漏了做市商中价与潜在价值的隐藏缺口，因此这是部分可观测问题，而非完全可观测马尔可夫决策过程。<bookmark mark='b'/>动作选择半价差与库存偏斜。<bookmark mark='c'/>奖励是按潜在价值计价的损益减风险惩罚。<bookmark mark='d'/>表格Q学习以恒定步长训练两万四千场，再用全新场次评估贪婪策略。经典收敛保证不能由此推出。

aadd6a2808e2.en: One illustrative session under the selected fixed rule. <bookmark mark='a'/> The informed observe current latent value; the maker sees trades instead. <bookmark mark='b'/> The maker's mid follows order flow and can lag the value. <bookmark mark='c'/> Inventory changes with fills and the skew encourages unloading. There are 110 trades in four hundred steps. This path illustrates the mechanism; it is not a performance distribution.
aadd6a2808e2.zh: 选定固定规则的一场示例。<bookmark mark='a'/>知情者观察当前潜在价值；做市商只能看交易。<bookmark mark='b'/>做市商中价跟随订单流，可能滞后于价值。<bookmark mark='c'/>成交改变库存，偏斜鼓励卸载。四百步中共有110笔交易。这条路径解释机制，不是完整表现分布。

ff04e4ccaf41.en: First, the eight fixed rules in the fifteen-percent market. <bookmark mark='a'/> In these evaluations, narrow quotes face adverse selection and wide quotes reduce noise participation. <bookmark mark='b'/> The highest mean in this tested grid is the skewed 3-tick rule at 157 per session. These scores include the inventory penalty. Selecting the best evaluated rule is a finite-grid comparison, not an independently confirmed global optimum.
ff04e4ccaf41.zh: 先看百分之十五知情者市场中的八条固定规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>这些评估中，窄报价面临逆向选择，宽报价降低噪声参与。<bookmark mark='b'/>测试网格内最高均值得分来自带偏斜的3跳规则，每场157。得分包含库存惩罚。从已评估规则中选最好者只是有限网格比较，并非独立确认的全局最优。

fe761b1101f8.en: Now the learners. <bookmark mark='a'/> The top row selects the highest mean among eight tested fixed rules in each market. <bookmark mark='b'/> The five-percent learner scores 153 in its training regime, about 85 percent of that grid benchmark's 179. <bookmark mark='c'/> In the thirty-percent market the two learners score 89 and 89. This one training seed and finite evaluation do not establish equivalence, convergence, or the value of further training. Repeated independent training runs would be needed to separate those effects.
fe761b1101f8.zh: 再看学习者。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一行在每种市场选取八条规则中均值最高者。<bookmark mark='b'/>百分之五学习者在训练环境得153，约为网格基准179的85%。<bookmark mark='c'/>在百分之三十市场，两名学习者分别得89与89。单个训练种子与有限评估不能证明等效、收敛或继续训练的价值；区分这些效应需要多次独立训练。

0900751587e5.en: Greedy-policy evaluations during this training run. <bookmark mark='a'/> At five hundred sessions the score is 156. <bookmark mark='b'/> A later snapshot reaches 114 after 12,000 sessions. <bookmark mark='c'/> The last scores 153, against the selected fixed benchmark's 179. Noisy snapshot scores need not improve monotonically. Constant step size, partial observation and finite samples prevent this curve from establishing convergence or proving that longer training cannot help.
0900751587e5.zh: 训练过程中贪婪策略的评估。<bookmark mark='a'/>五百场时得分156。<bookmark mark='b'/>在12000场后的某次快照降至114。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后为153，选定固定基准为179。带噪声的快照得分不必单调提高。恒定步长、部分可观测性与有限样本，意味着这条曲线不能证明收敛，也不能证明延长训练无用。

dd73182de415.en: Why a simple rule can be competitive. <bookmark mark='a'/> With an isolated exponential fill law, maximising distance times fill rate gives one over k. That is a useful reference, not the exact optimal quote in this partially observed dealer model. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here one over k is two ticks, while adverse selection and inventory incentives alter the tested rule's performance. <bookmark mark='c'/> Structural knowledge can reduce the search burden. The comparison is conditional on this model, these actions and this training budget; it does not establish a universal winner between model-based and learned policies.
dd73182de415.zh: 简单规则为何可能有竞争力。<bookmark mark='a'/>单独考虑指数成交率，最大化报价距离乘成交率得到k的倒数。这是参考，不是这个部分可观测交易商模型的精确最优报价。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里k倒数为两跳，而逆向选择和库存激励会改变测试规则的表现。<bookmark mark='c'/>结构知识能缩小搜索负担。比较依赖模型、动作集与训练预算，不建立模型方法与学习方法之间的普遍胜负。

6191f5f36983.en: The easy-market learner's frozen policy after a quiet step. <bookmark mark='a'/> Near flat it selects widths from two to four ticks. <bookmark mark='b'/> With inventory it often skews toward unloading. Neighbouring cells can disagree, but the table alone does not tell us whether rare visits, reward noise or hidden-state aliasing caused the differences. It shows the chosen actions rather than identifying why they were learned.
6191f5f36983.zh: 简单市场学习者在安静一步后的冻结策略。<bookmark mark='a'/>库存接近零时选择两至四跳宽度。<bookmark mark='b'/>有库存时经常向卸载方向偏斜。相邻单元可能不同，但仅凭策略表无法判断原因是访问稀少、奖励噪声还是隐藏状态混叠。它展示选择了什么，不识别为何学到这些选择。

b9c58670e13e.en: The regime comparison. <bookmark mark='a'/> The easy-market learner averages about three ticks. <bookmark mark='b'/> The hard-market learner quotes more tightly in this run. These averages depend on both policy and visited observations; they do not identify a structural response to informed trading. <bookmark mark='c'/> Finite training, hidden state and distribution shift are confounded here. The result motivates repeated training and controlled evaluation, rather than proving that regime choice is irrelevant.
b9c58670e13e.zh: 训练环境比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>简单市场学习者的平均报价约三跳。<bookmark mark='b'/>困难市场学习者在这次运行报得更紧。平均值同时取决于策略与访问的观测，不能识别对知情交易的结构响应。<bookmark mark='c'/>有限训练、隐藏状态与分布变化在这里混杂。结果提示需要重复训练与受控评估，不证明环境选择无关。

30e6510592c9.en: And why a backtest is not an environment. Record a session of the two-tick rule: who traded, and when. <bookmark mark='a'/> Live, it earns 143. <bookmark mark='b'/> Now evaluate a four-tick rule on that tape, the usual way: same trades, two ticks better each. It looks worth 445. <bookmark mark='c'/> Run it live and it earns 129, less than the two-tick rule, because wider quotes drive the noise traders away. The tape recorded who traded with the old quotes, not who would have traded with the new ones.
30e6510592c9.zh: 以及为什么回测不是环境。记录两单位规则的一场交易：谁交易了，什么时候。<bookmark mark='a'/>实盘中它赚143。<bookmark mark='b'/>现在用通常的方法在这份记录上评估四单位规则：同样的交易，每笔好两个单位。它看起来值445。<bookmark mark='c'/>实盘运行，它只赚129，比两单位规则还少，因为更宽的报价把噪声交易者赶走了。成交记录记下的是谁和旧报价交易，而不是谁会和新报价交易。

09cd8a3a290d.en: Offline policy evaluation asks what a new policy would earn from an old policy's logged experience. <bookmark mark='a'/> Logs contain chosen actions and subsequent outcomes. <bookmark mark='b'/> A new sequential policy can change future observations as well as current rewards. <bookmark mark='c'/> Trajectory importance weighting therefore uses products of action-probability ratios, under consistent propensities, suitable observation or confounding assumptions, and sequential overlap. <bookmark mark='d'/> It can have extreme variance. A deterministic two-tick log has no support for four ticks; reusing its fills cannot supply the missing counterfactual.
09cd8a3a290d.zh: 离线策略评估利用旧策略记录，询问新策略能赚多少。<bookmark mark='a'/>日志记录选过的动作与后续结果。<bookmark mark='b'/>新序贯策略会改变未来观测，而不只改变当前奖励。<bookmark mark='c'/>轨迹重要性加权因此使用动作概率比的连乘，并需要可靠倾向概率、适当的观测或混杂假设以及序贯重叠。<bookmark mark='d'/>方差可能极大。确定性两跳报价记录没有四跳动作的支持；沿用成交无法补出缺失的反事实。

258a7744c5bf.en: Why a table, when the field uses deep networks? <bookmark mark='a'/> Deep reinforcement learning replaces the table by a network, or learns the policy directly, so that states too numerous to list, like a whole order book, can be handled. <bookmark mark='b'/> It does not fix the sample efficiency, the simulator's assumptions or the missing counterfactual, and a network can overfit a simulator's quirks more thoroughly. <bookmark mark='c'/> Thirty-nine observations can be printed and read, so the House can see what was learned, not only what it earned.
258a7744c5bf.zh: 为什么用表格，而领域里常用深度网络？<bookmark mark='a'/>深度强化学习用网络替代表格，或直接学习策略，从而处理完整订单簿等难以枚举的观测。<bookmark mark='b'/>它不会自动修复样本效率、模拟假设或缺失的反事实，网络还可能更彻底地过拟合模拟器特点。<bookmark mark='c'/>三十九种观测的策略表可以直接打印阅读，让我们看到选择了什么，而不只是赚了多少。

ce27a20db095.en: Pause and predict. Language models read the news and write trading plans. What is the hardest problem in testing one on historical data?
ce27a20db095.zh: 暂停并预测。语言模型阅读新闻、撰写交易计划。在历史数据上检验它，最难的问题是什么？

1d3e3b1c77a4.en: Chapter five. A language model may have encountered later news about historical test events during training. A training cutoff does not prove it read every event, but contamination can make apparent trading skill difficult to distinguish from recall. Part twenty-eight examined this timing problem with small chronologically consistent models. Here we discuss evaluation requirements; no language-model trader is executed in this part.
1d3e3b1c77a4.zh: 第五章。语言模型可能在训练中遇到历史测试事件的后续新闻。截止日期并不证明它读过每件事，但污染会让交易能力难以与回忆区分。第二十八部分用小型时间一致模型研究了这个问题。这里讨论评估要求，没有运行语言模型交易者。

21b34290e084.en: Three ways they are used, as the research describes them. <bookmark mark='a'/> As readers: a model scores news for a separate trading rule, Part twenty-eight's tone. <bookmark mark='b'/> As planners: an agent reads, reasons in text and outputs an order, sometimes as a pipeline of analyst, trader and risk manager. <bookmark mark='c'/> And as populations: many agents in one simulated market, to see what prices they make together.
21b34290e084.zh: 按研究文献的描述，它们有三种用法。<bookmark mark='a'/>作为阅读者：模型给新闻打分，供另一条交易规则使用，即第28部分的语气。<bookmark mark='b'/>作为规划者：一个智能体阅读、用文字推理并输出订单，有时是分析师、交易员和风险经理组成的流水线。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及作为群体：许多智能体在同一个模拟市场里，看它们一起形成什么价格。

158eb55e5e10.en: Why simulators can help test language models. <bookmark mark='a'/> Historical outcomes may overlap training material. <bookmark mark='b'/> Newly generated events reduce direct outcome recall, but familiar templates, benchmark leakage and exploitable simulator rules can remain. Synthetic novelty alone is not a clean test of general reasoning. <bookmark mark='c'/> Results are evidence about that simulated environment. Transfer to real execution and unfamiliar market conditions requires separate validation.
158eb55e5e10.zh: 模拟器为何可能帮助测试语言模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>历史结果可能与训练材料重叠。<bookmark mark='b'/>新生成事件减少直接回忆结果，但熟悉模板、基准泄漏与可利用的模拟规则仍可能存在。合成新颖性本身不是一般推理的干净检验。<bookmark mark='c'/>结果是关于那个模拟环境的证据，迁移到真实执行和陌生市场需要另行验证。

6ea8902f6c42.en: What an honest test would need. <bookmark mark='a'/> Training data that end before the test window begins. <bookmark mark='b'/> A registered record of prompts, versions and every run, because each rewording is another trial on the counter. <bookmark mark='c'/> Costs, and Part twenty-six's deflation for the number tried. <bookmark mark='d'/> And a baseline: the simplest rule using the same text. What the language model adds is the difference.
6ea8902f6c42.zh: 一个诚实的检验需要什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>在检验窗口开始之前就结束的训练数据。<bookmark mark='b'/>提示词、版本和每一次运行的登记记录，因为每次改写措辞都是计数器上的又一次试验。<bookmark mark='c'/>成本，以及第26部分针对尝试次数的折减。<bookmark mark='d'/>以及一个基准：使用同样文本的最简单规则。语言模型增加的就是两者之差。

da150e307381.en: Two ways to improve timing discipline. <bookmark mark='a'/> Use a frozen model whose training information predates the whole test window, or use documented rolling vintages. A new model for every date is not required. <bookmark mark='b'/> Historical vintages test those older models and their recorded information sets. <bookmark mark='c'/> A prospective test after release also needs frozen prompts, data rules, model versions and a record of all trials. Release timing alone does not prevent adaptation to test outcomes.
da150e307381.zh: 改善时间纪律的两种方式。<bookmark mark='a'/>用训练信息早于整个测试窗口的冻结模型，或记录完整的滚动版本，不必每天训练新模型。<bookmark mark='b'/>历史版本检验的是那些旧模型及其信息集。<bookmark mark='c'/>发布后的前瞻测试也要冻结提示、数据规则和模型版本，并记录所有尝试。仅靠发布日期无法防止根据测试结果调整。

325f45665d41.en: A potential concentration risk. <bookmark mark='a'/> The Financial Stability Board's twenty twenty-four report discussed reliance on common AI providers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Shared models and inputs can correlate decisions, but prompts, constraints and execution can also make actions differ. <bookmark mark='c'/> Chapter seven isolates a common-signal mechanism. Sharing a model alone does not imply herding or the stationary distribution of Chapter two's particular imitation chain.
325f45665d41.zh: 一种潜在集中风险。<bookmark mark='a'/>金融稳定理事会二〇二四年的报告讨论了对共同人工智能供应商的依赖。<bookmark mark='b'/>共享模型和输入可能让决策相关，但提示、约束与执行也可能造成差异。<bookmark mark='c'/>第七章隔离共同信号机制。仅共享模型不意味着羊群行为，更不意味着第二章特定模仿链的平稳分布。

0c4fa8150f8b.en: Possible market effects depend on deployment. <bookmark mark='a'/> Faster text processing can speed some information into prices, but errors and execution frictions remain. <bookmark mark='b'/> Similar inputs and decision rules can create correlated order flow; this is a risk mechanism, not a measured universal outcome. <bookmark mark='c'/> Misleading or malicious text can affect machine readers. Provenance, validation, access controls and risk limits all matter; no single defence eliminates that risk.
0c4fa8150f8b.zh: 可能的市场影响取决于部署。<bookmark mark='a'/>更快的文本处理可能加速某些信息进入价格，但错误和执行摩擦仍在。<bookmark mark='b'/>相似输入与决策规则可能产生相关订单流；这是风险机制，不是已经测量的普遍结果。<bookmark mark='c'/>误导或恶意文本可能影响机器阅读者。来源验证、内容校验、访问控制与风险限额都重要，没有单一防线消除全部风险。

63e2e9aab261.en: What this part establishes. <bookmark mark='a'/> It runs no language model as a trader, so it supplies no direct performance evidence about one. <bookmark mark='b'/> The small dealer simulator and fixed-rule baselines illustrate some evaluation problems. A real trial would additionally need a frozen information set, costs and complete prospective accounting of configurations. <bookmark mark='c'/> Results here cannot establish the current absence or presence of profitable language-model trading at scale. That is a separate empirical question.
63e2e9aab261.zh: 本部分能建立什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>没有运行语言模型交易者，因此没有它的直接表现证据。<bookmark mark='b'/>小型交易商模拟和固定规则基准说明一些评估问题。真实试验还需要冻结信息集、成本与全部配置的前瞻记录。<bookmark mark='c'/>这些结果不能证明当今大规模语言模型交易是否盈利，那是独立的经验问题。

3a4f5dafe1b1.en: Pause and predict. Two pricing algorithms learn by trial and error. They never communicate, and they set prices against each other again and again. Do they end up at competitive prices?
3a4f5dafe1b1.zh: 暂停并预测。两个定价算法通过试错学习。它们从不交流，一次又一次地相互定价。它们最终会停在竞争性价格上吗？

fef28aa130b9.en: Chapter six. In this fixed-budget pricing experiment, the high-discount learners' mean price is 1.77, compared with continuous-action Nash 1.47 and joint-monopoly 1.92. Their profit interpolation index is 81 percent of the gap between those benchmark profits. That percentage is not a fraction of the price gap. The algorithms exchange no explicit messages, but observe each other's previous prices.
fef28aa130b9.zh: 第六章。在这个固定训练预算的定价实验中，高折扣学习者的平均价格为1.77，连续动作纳什基准为1.47，联合垄断基准为1.92。利润插值指数为两者基准利润差距的81%，并不是价格差距的百分比。算法不交换明确消息，但观察对方上一期价格。

6028646dd15c.en: The experiment, from Emilio Calvano, Giacomo Calzolari, Vincenzo Denicolò and Sergio Pastorello. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two firms sell similar goods against logit demand. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each earns its margin times its demand. <bookmark mark='c'/> If they meet once, each best-responds and the price is 1.47; a monopolist owning both would charge 1.92. <bookmark mark='d'/> The algorithms choose from fifteen prices spanning both.
6028646dd15c.zh: 这个实验来自埃米利奥·卡尔瓦诺、贾科莫·卡尔佐拉里、温琴佐·德尼科洛和塞尔吉奥·帕斯托雷洛。<bookmark mark='a'/>两家公司在logit需求下出售相似的商品。<bookmark mark='b'/>每家赚取它的利润率乘以需求。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果只相遇一次，各自作出最优反应，价格是1.47；拥有两家的垄断者会定价1.92。<bookmark mark='d'/>算法从跨越两者的十五个价格中选择。

25b48eaeebef.en: The learners. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each remembers only last period's two prices. <bookmark mark='b'/> It keeps a table of how good each price is in each state, and nudges the entry toward the profit it got plus the discounted value of what comes next: Part eight's Q-learning. <bookmark mark='c'/> It explores at random, less and less. <bookmark mark='d'/> Ninety-six independent sessions of a million and a half periods each. The measure: how far profits sit between competition, zero, and monopoly, one.
25b48eaeebef.zh: 学习者。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个只记得上一期的两个价格。<bookmark mark='b'/>它保存一张表，记录每个状态下每个价格有多好，并把表中的条目向所得利润加上下一步的折现价值推进一点：第8部分的Q学习。<bookmark mark='c'/>它随机探索，并越来越少。<bookmark mark='d'/>九十六个独立场次，每场一百五十万期。度量：利润位于竞争（零）和垄断（一）之间的什么位置。

8d7543ec4b30.en: Results across the tested discount factors. <bookmark mark='a'/> Myopic learners have mean profit index 0.23. Grid effects and finite learning can put this above continuous-action Nash. <bookmark mark='b'/> The high-discount runs have larger average indices, but the tested sequence is not monotone: it first dips at discount point two five. <bookmark mark='c'/> At discount nought point nine five the index is 0.81. These finite runs show supra-competitive outcomes; they do not prove convergence or that patience is necessary for every form of algorithmic price elevation.
8d7543ec4b30.zh: 测试折扣因子的结果。<bookmark mark='a'/>短视学习者的平均利润指数为0.23。网格效应与有限学习可以使其高于连续动作纳什。<bookmark mark='b'/>高折扣运行的平均指数更大，但测试序列并不单调：在折扣点二五时先下降。<bookmark mark='c'/>折扣点九五时，指数为0.81。有限运行展示超竞争结果，不证明收敛，也不证明耐心是所有算法抬价机制的必要条件。

d9ca8c219ade.en: At discount nought point nine five, each dot summarises one frozen pair's post-training prices. <bookmark mark='a'/> The continuous Nash and monopoly points are references, not the complete equilibria of the fifteen-price game. <bookmark mark='b'/> Equal prices occur in 32 percent of sessions. The remaining policies may cycle or be asymmetric. The recurrence search is capped at two hundred steps, below the two hundred twenty-five possible states. <bookmark mark='c'/> Among the 56 sessions classified as fixed points, 95 percent meet this forced-undercut punishment criterion. This conditional percentage is not a rate across all sessions or proof of subgame perfection.
d9ca8c219ade.zh: 折扣点九五时，每个点概括一对冻结策略训练后的价格。<bookmark mark='a'/>连续纳什与垄断点只是参考，不是十五价格博弈的完整均衡。<bookmark mark='b'/>有32%场次价格相同；其余可能循环或不对称。重复状态搜索最多两百步，少于两百二十五个可能状态。<bookmark mark='c'/>在归为固定点的56场中，95%符合这项被迫降价后的惩罚标准。这是条件比例，不是所有场次的比例，也不证明子博弈完美性。

57c91b1fab90.en: A forced-deviation diagnostic, conditional on 56 sessions classified as fixed points. <bookmark mark='a'/> Firm one is forced to its best response for one period, after which both frozen policies resume. <bookmark mark='b'/> The mean rival price falls. <bookmark mark='c'/> The average response returns near its starting level after about 5 periods. A return in the mean does not imply every session returns. This reward-and-punishment pattern is evidence of possible coordination, not a proof of equilibrium, intent or a legal agreement.
57c91b1fab90.zh: 被迫偏离诊断，条件是被归为固定点的56场。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一家公司被迫使用一期最佳响应，随后双方恢复冻结策略。<bookmark mark='b'/>对手平均价格下降。<bookmark mark='c'/>平均响应约在5期后回到起点附近。均值回归不等于每场都回归。奖惩图案是可能协调的证据，不证明均衡、意图或法律上的协议。

10197c44d6ad.en: In financial markets. <bookmark mark='a'/> Jean-Edouard Colliard, Thierry Foucault and Stefano Lovo put Q-learning dealers against each other: their spreads sit above the competitive level, but less so when adverse selection makes profits riskier, as they report. <bookmark mark='b'/> Winston Dou, Itay Goldstein and Yan Ji gave learning algorithms to informed speculators: they trade less aggressively than competition would make them, and prices carry less information. <bookmark mark='c'/> For a dealer the price is the spread, and a punishment is a tighter quote after a rival undercuts.
10197c44d6ad.zh: 在金融市场中。<bookmark mark='a'/>让-爱德华·科利亚尔、蒂埃里·富科和斯特凡诺·洛沃让Q学习交易商相互竞争：据他们报告，价差高于竞争水平，但当逆向选择让利润风险更大时，高得少一些。<bookmark mark='b'/>窦文斯、伊塔伊·戈德斯坦和季妍把学习算法交给知情投机者：它们交易得没有竞争所要求的那么激进，价格包含的信息也更少。<bookmark mark='c'/>对交易商来说价格就是价差，而惩罚就是在对手降价之后报得更紧。

83b8ee103ff2.en: A separate payoff-noise experiment. Independent zero-mean noise is added to period profits; it is not an adverse-selection model. <bookmark mark='a'/> The plotted outcomes depend on the tested noise levels and finite learning budget. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the largest level the mean profit index is 0.43. Noise can disrupt learned reward signals, but this experiment does not identify the effect of informed traders, who change conditional payoffs and incentives.
83b8ee103ff2.zh: 另一个收益噪声实验。在每期利润上加入独立零均值噪声，它不是逆向选择模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>图中结果取决于所测噪声水平与有限学习预算。<bookmark mark='b'/>最大噪声下平均利润指数为0.43。噪声可能干扰学习奖励，但这个实验不能识别知情者的影响，因为知情者会改变条件收益与激励。

016144ebc598.en: Some conditions can facilitate coordination. <bookmark mark='a'/> Few sellers, repeated interaction, observable prices and stable demand appear in the industrial-organisation literature. <bookmark mark='b'/> Algorithms can interact frequently and retain histories, but their information, constraints and learning rules vary. <bookmark mark='c'/> Electronic markets can combine rapid interaction with concentrated participation. Hidden liquidity, asynchronous decisions, entry and adverse selection complicate the analogy; automation alone does not imply collusion.
016144ebc598.zh: 有些条件可能便利协调。<bookmark mark='a'/>产业组织文献讨论少数卖家、重复交互、可观测价格和稳定需求。<bookmark mark='b'/>算法可以频繁交互并保留历史，但其信息、约束和学习规则不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>电子市场可能同时具有快速交互与集中参与。隐藏流动性、异步决策、进入与逆向选择使类比复杂；自动化本身不意味着合谋。

c4b72e849fe5.en: And why the number of sellers matters, in one line of algebra. <bookmark mark='a'/> With identical goods, colluding firms split the monopoly profit, a firm that undercuts slightly takes all of it, and competition leaves nothing. <bookmark mark='b'/> The research chapter's threshold becomes one minus one over n. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two sellers need a discount factor of a half; ten need nine tenths. Calvano and coauthors report less collusion with three and four learners, as the formula suggests.
c4b72e849fe5.zh: 以及卖家数量为什么重要，用一行代数说明。<bookmark mark='a'/>商品完全相同时，合谋的公司平分垄断利润，稍微降价的公司拿走全部，而竞争什么也不留。<bookmark mark='b'/>研究者章节的阈值变成一减n分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个卖家需要折现因子一半；十个需要十分之九。卡尔瓦诺和合作者报告，三个和四个学习者时合谋更少，正如公式所示。

679a16f75ab5.en: Economic and legal questions differ. <bookmark mark='a'/> High prices plus a retaliatory response are coordination diagnostics, but frozen policies require further deviation checks before equilibrium claims. <bookmark mark='b'/> Legal treatment depends on jurisdiction, agreement, information exchange and conduct. A simulation cannot establish a violation or a general safe harbour. <bookmark mark='c'/> Assad and coauthors report evidence from German petrol pricing that margins rose where both stations in local duopolies adopted algorithms. That empirical setting is distinct from this simulator.
679a16f75ab5.zh: 经济问题与法律问题不同。<bookmark mark='a'/>高价与报复响应是协调诊断，但冻结策略还需进一步偏离检验，才能讨论均衡。<bookmark mark='b'/>法律处理取决于司法辖区、协议、信息交换和具体行为。模拟不能确认违法，也不能提供普遍免责。<bookmark mark='c'/>阿萨德等人报告，德国汽油定价中，局部双寡头双方都采用算法时利润率上升。该经验场景与本模拟不同。

e9533f0e0c41.en: A dated example of enforcement allegations. <bookmark mark='a'/> In August twenty twenty-four the US Justice Department sued RealPage over alleged coordination through rent-pricing software and shared information. This describes that complaint, not the case's current status or a finding of liability. <bookmark mark='b'/> A shared pricing intermediary is structurally different from two independent learners in our experiment. <bookmark mark='c'/> Vendor models deserve scrutiny for shared information, constraints and feedback, without assuming that licensing one model itself establishes unlawful coordination.
e9533f0e0c41.zh: 一个带日期的执法指控例子。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇二四年八月，美国司法部起诉RealPage，指控其租金定价软件与共享信息促成协调。这里描述当时的起诉，不说明案件当前状态，也不是责任认定。<bookmark mark='b'/>共同定价中介与实验中的两名独立学习者结构不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>供应商模型应审查共享信息、约束与反馈，不能仅凭共同许可就认定非法协调。

bf853dc604c1.en: Pause and predict. A hundred traders use orders x i equal to point two times a common signal plus point eight times a private signal. All signal components are independent, mean zero and unit variance. What fraction of the variance of their summed order flow comes from the common signal?
bf853dc604c1.zh: 暂停并预测。一百名交易者的订单等于共同信号的点二倍，加私有信号的点八倍。所有信号分量相互独立、均值为零、方差为一。总订单流方差中，多大比例来自共同信号？

69c1556304a9.en: Chapter seven. Under the pause's independent unit-variance signal assumptions, the common component accounts for 86 percent of aggregate flow variance. Point two is a signal coefficient, not a realised fraction of every trade. Private components partly diversify rather than cancelling exactly. This arithmetic illustrates one common-input mechanism; sharing a model does not by itself establish these assumptions in a real market.
69c1556304a9.zh: 第七章。在暂停问题的独立、单位方差信号假设下，共同分量占总订单流方差的86%。点二是信号系数，不是每笔实际交易的固定比例。私有分量部分分散化，而非精确抵消。这个算术说明一种共同输入机制，共用模型本身不证明真实市场满足这些假设。

3d9cf5ff32a1.en: The concern, stated before the language-model boom. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gary Gensler and Lily Bailey argued in twenty twenty that deep learning could raise systemic risk through uniformity: similar models, trained on similar data, bought from few providers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Jon Danielsson, Robert Macrae and Andreas Uthemann argued that risk engines that learn the same lessons make risk management more procyclical. <bookmark mark='c'/> The mechanism is not a bad model. It is the same model everywhere, so that one error is everyone's error at once.
3d9cf5ff32a1.zh: 这个担忧在语言模型热潮之前就已提出。<bookmark mark='a'/>加里·根斯勒和莉莉·贝利在二〇二〇年指出，深度学习可能通过单一化提高系统性风险：相似的模型，用相似的数据训练，从少数供应商处购买。<bookmark mark='b'/>乔恩·丹尼尔松、罗伯特·麦克雷和安德烈亚斯·乌特曼指出，学到同样教训的风险引擎会让风险管理更加顺周期。<bookmark mark='c'/>机制不是一个坏模型，而是同一个模型无处不在，于是一个错误同时成了所有人的错误。

e0caa7d6bf48.en: The arithmetic. <bookmark mark='a'/> The common signal and all private components are independent with zero means and unit variances. Orders themselves are correlated. <bookmark mark='b'/> Summed flow has common variance N squared w squared and private variance N times the square of one minus w. <bookmark mark='c'/> Their ratio gives the common fraction. At fixed positive w it increases with N. <bookmark mark='d'/> For w point two and N one hundred, it is four over four point six four, about eighty-six percent. This is a variance fraction, not a share of realised order volume.
e0caa7d6bf48.zh: 计算如下。<bookmark mark='a'/>共同信号与所有私有分量相互独立，均值为零、方差为一；订单本身却相关。<bookmark mark='b'/>总订单流的共同方差为人数平方乘权重平方，私有方差为人数乘一减权重的平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者的比率给出共同份额。固定正权重时，它随人数增加。<bookmark mark='d'/>权重点二、人数一百时，四除以四点六四，约百分之八十六。这是方差份额，不是已实现订单量份额。

15fd0c50bfb1.en: A hundred traders with linear price impact. <bookmark mark='a'/> At common coefficient point two, simulated volatility is 2.2 times the zero-common benchmark. <bookmark mark='b'/> The theoretical curve uses unmodified unit-variance signals; the five-thousand-observation simulation includes one inserted shock, so its dots need not equal that curve. Total variance initially falls to its minimum at w equal to one over N plus one, then rises. <bookmark mark='c'/> Labels show theoretical common variance fractions, not the fraction of everything the market trades or a measured AI contribution.
15fd0c50bfb1.zh: 一百名交易者，采用线性价格冲击。<bookmark mark='a'/>共同系数点二时，模拟波动为零共同基准的2.2倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>理论曲线使用未修改的单位方差信号；五千个观测的模拟包含一次插入冲击，因此点不必精确落在线上。总方差先下降，在权重等于人数加一的倒数时最小，然后上升。<bookmark mark='c'/>标签是理论共同方差份额，不是全部交易的比例，更不是测量出的人工智能贡献。

b9a24540e9d5.en: One deliberately inserted shock. The source adds positive four to the existing random common signal on the selected day. <bookmark mark='a'/> At zero common weight, that addition has no effect, but private orders still generate a return. <bookmark mark='b'/> At weight point two, the selected day's total return is 11 baseline volatility units. That includes the original random signals; the inserted addition alone contributes eight units. This upward realisation illustrates amplification, not a downward crash, a four-sigma total draw or a frequency estimate.
b9a24540e9d5.zh: 一次刻意插入的冲击。代码在选定日已有的随机共同信号上加正四。<bookmark mark='a'/>共同权重为零时，这个增量没有作用，但私有订单仍产生收益。<bookmark mark='b'/>权重点二时，该日总收益为基准波动的11倍，其中包含原来的随机信号；插入的增量本身贡献八倍。这个向上实现值说明放大机制，不是向下崩盘、总计四标准差抽样或频率估计。

34a93e0011c4.en: A possible empirical diagnostic. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fit a factor model to a vector of order flows. <bookmark mark='b'/> The displayed variance fraction assumes factor-residual orthogonality and a suitable factor specification. <bookmark mark='c'/> More common variation can reflect shared news, benchmarks or rebalancing as well as similar models. It does not identify AI uniformity or predict a crisis on its own. Data coverage and model uncertainty must accompany any reported estimate.
34a93e0011c4.zh: 一种可能的经验诊断。<bookmark mark='a'/>对订单流向量拟合因子模型。<bookmark mark='b'/>显示的方差比例要求因子与残差正交，并有适当的因子设定。<bookmark mark='c'/>共同变化增加，可能来自共享新闻、基准或再平衡，也可能来自相似模型。它本身不识别人工智能同质化，也不预测危机。报告估计必须同时说明数据覆盖与模型不确定性。

f8ed3f0497f8.en: Three implications, conditional on the mechanism. <bookmark mark='a'/> Shared exposures can create an externality when firms do not bear all amplification costs. Diversity can help, but its value depends on accuracy, liquidity and responses. <bookmark mark='b'/> Different data, horizons and objectives may reduce alignment; market controls need their own evaluation. <bookmark mark='c'/> Test a strategy against copies of itself and alternative populations. This is a stress scenario rather than a prediction that successful strategies will all be copied.
f8ed3f0497f8.zh: 依赖机制的三个启示。<bookmark mark='a'/>当企业不承担全部放大成本时，共同敞口可能产生外部性。多样性可能有帮助，但价值取决于准确性、流动性与响应。<bookmark mark='b'/>不同数据、期限和目标可能降低同步；市场控制措施也需独立评估。<bookmark mark='c'/>测试策略面对复制品与其他群体的表现，这是压力情景，不是成功策略必被复制的预测。

eecd55389753.en: Pause and predict. The International Monetary Fund and the Financial Stability Board both reported on artificial intelligence in finance in twenty twenty-four. What do you think worried them most?
eecd55389753.zh: 暂停并预测。国际货币基金组织和金融稳定理事会都在二〇二四年发布了关于金融业人工智能的报告。你认为最让它们担心的是什么？

f6a276b626c8.en: Chapter eight. The dated twenty twenty-four IMF and Financial Stability Board reports identified correlation and provider concentration among potential risks, alongside cyber, operational and model risks. They discussed mechanisms and important information gaps. This chapter describes that historical assessment, not a claim about the current prevalence or absence of AI-driven instability.
f6a276b626c8.zh: 第八章。二〇二四年国际货币基金组织与金融稳定理事会的报告，将相关性和供应商集中列为潜在风险，并讨论网络、操作和模型风险。它们分析机制及重要信息缺口。本章描述当时的评估，不声称人工智能所致不稳定如今存在多少或是否不存在。

36dc1228701e.en: The reports in their historical framing. <bookmark mark='a'/> The IMF's October twenty twenty-four report discussed faster trading, correlated strategies and potential stress amplification, with implications for market safeguards. <bookmark mark='b'/> The FSB's November report highlighted provider dependence, market correlations, cyber risk, model risk and governance. <bookmark mark='c'/> It called for better monitoring and closing information gaps. Those reports are dated evidence about potential vulnerabilities, not a current estimate of realised systemic effects.
36dc1228701e.zh: 按历史时间理解这些报告。<bookmark mark='a'/>国际货币基金组织二〇二四年十月报告讨论更快交易、相关策略和潜在压力放大，以及对市场保障措施的影响。<bookmark mark='b'/>金融稳定理事会十一月报告强调供应商依赖、市场相关性、网络、模型和治理风险。<bookmark mark='c'/>它呼吁加强监测、弥补信息缺口。这些是潜在脆弱性的历史证据，不是当前系统实际影响的估计。

26c1e0b42b76.en: Selected rules and historical dates, rather than a complete legal survey. <bookmark mark='a'/> EU requirements for covered investment firms engaged in algorithmic trading include testing, pre-trade controls and kill functionality. <bookmark mark='b'/> The US market-access rule applies to broker-dealers with relevant market access and requires financial and regulatory controls. <bookmark mark='c'/> The EU AI Act names natural-person creditworthiness and life or health insurance risk assessment among high-risk uses. Its scope and phased application require separate analysis; trading is not categorically exempt from AI, data or financial law. <bookmark mark='d'/> The SEC withdrew its twenty twenty-three predictive-analytics conflicts proposal in June twenty twenty-five. This is the history of that proposal, not a statement that no other duties apply.
26c1e0b42b76.zh: 以下是选定规则与历史日期，并非完整法律综述。<bookmark mark='a'/>欧盟对适用的算法交易投资公司要求测试、交易前控制与停止功能。<bookmark mark='b'/>美国市场准入规则适用于具有相关市场准入的经纪交易商，要求财务及监管风险控制。<bookmark mark='c'/>欧盟人工智能法将自然人信用评估、人寿或健康保险风险评估列为高风险用途。适用范围和分阶段实施须单独分析；交易并非一概豁免人工智能、数据或金融法律。<bookmark mark='d'/>美国证交会在二〇二五年六月撤回了二〇二三年的预测分析利益冲突提案。这是该提案的历史，不意味着其他义务不存在。

81402a98bc3f.en: Andrei Kirilenko and Andrew Lo put the problem in two laws. <bookmark mark='a'/> Moore's law: computing keeps getting faster and cheaper, so more trading is automated. <bookmark mark='b'/> Murphy's law: whatever can go wrong will, and at machine speed it goes wrong before anyone can step in. <bookmark mark='c'/> The risk is the gap between them: technology that outruns the controls built for slower markets.
81402a98bc3f.zh: 安德烈·基里连科和罗闻全用两条定律概括这个问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>摩尔定律：计算越来越快、越来越便宜，所以更多交易被自动化。<bookmark mark='b'/>墨菲定律：凡是可能出错的都会出错，而在机器速度下，它会在任何人能干预之前就出错。<bookmark mark='c'/>风险就在两者之间的差距：技术跑在了为更慢的市场设计的控制之前。

f3f9b8eb00c7.en: Different historical failures illustrate different controls. <bookmark mark='a'/> The twenty ten flash crash involved stressed order flow and liquidity feedback. <bookmark mark='b'/> Knight Capital's twenty twelve deployment and routing failure generated unwanted positions; the SEC later reported losses above four hundred sixty million dollars. <bookmark mark='c'/> The twenty fourteen Treasury event included a sixteen-basis-point yield round trip in twelve minutes, without an apparent new public catalyst in that narrow window. <bookmark mark='d'/> Sterling fell sharply in thin Asian trading in twenty sixteen. <bookmark mark='e'/> These are not established examples of language-model trading failures, nor do they share one proven cause. Knight in particular was an operational failure, not simply simultaneous liquidity withdrawal.
f3f9b8eb00c7.zh: 不同历史故障说明不同控制问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇一〇年闪电崩盘涉及受压订单流与流动性反馈。<bookmark mark='b'/>Knight Capital二〇一二年的部署及路由故障产生不想持有的仓位；证交会后来报告损失超过四亿六千万美元。<bookmark mark='c'/>二〇一四年国债事件在十二分钟内出现十六基点收益率往返，该狭窄窗口没有明显新的公开催化信息。<bookmark mark='d'/>二〇一六年英镑在清淡亚洲时段大跌。<bookmark mark='e'/>这些并非已确立的语言模型交易失败案例，也没有共同的单一已证原因。Knight尤其是操作故障，不只是流动性同时撤走。

9d9c59da21bd.en: Model-risk management offers an older framework. <bookmark mark='a'/> US banking guidance issued in twenty eleven emphasised independent validation, documented limitations and monitoring, scaled to model use and risk. <bookmark mark='b'/> Retraining changes the model, so validation should address the training procedure, data changes and deployment controls as well as individual versions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Firms and designated people retain responsibilities under the applicable regimes. A simulator's approval label does not substitute for those duties.
9d9c59da21bd.zh: 模型风险管理提供较早的框架。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇一一年美国银行监管指引强调独立验证、限制记录与监测，并根据用途和风险调整。<bookmark mark='b'/>重新训练改变模型，因此验证应覆盖训练过程、数据变化与部署控制，也要检查具体版本。<bookmark mark='c'/>企业和指定人员仍承担适用制度下的责任。模拟器的批准标签不能替代这些义务。

8284c1dde679.en: So the controls come in three layers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Inside the firm: limits and kill switches outside the model, which it cannot learn its way around. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the exchange: price bands, pauses and batch auctions that slow a crowd down. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in the system: diversity of models, data and providers, and better data to measure concentration and common exposures.
8284c1dde679.zh: 控制分三个层次。<bookmark mark='a'/>企业内部：限制与停止开关位于模型之外，模型不能通过学习绕开。<bookmark mark='b'/>交易所：价格带、暂停与集合竞价可以减缓群体速度。<bookmark mark='c'/>系统层面：关注模型、数据与供应商的多样性，并改善测量集中度和共同敞口的数据。

6dd05dc054a2.en: Pause and predict. Before the House lets a learned agent trade, what should it be tested against, besides the market it was trained on?
6dd05dc054a2.zh: 暂停并预测。在本系列公司让一个学习型智能体交易之前，除了它受训的市场，还应该用什么来检验它？

eec87d144494.en: Four proposed evaluation dimensions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Test regimes unlike training. <bookmark mark='b'/> Test copies and alternative opponents. <bookmark mark='c'/> Force deviations and examine responses; retaliation is a coordination warning rather than a standalone equilibrium or legal test. <bookmark mark='d'/> Use an interactive simulator where quotes change fills, while recognising that simulated execution is still not real-market deployment evidence.
eec87d144494.zh: 建议四个评估维度。<bookmark mark='a'/>测试不同于训练的环境。<bookmark mark='b'/>测试复制品和其他对手。<bookmark mark='c'/>强迫偏离并检查响应；报复是协调预警，而非单独的均衡或法律检验。<bookmark mark='d'/>使用报价能改变成交的交互模拟器，同时承认模拟执行仍不是真实市场部署证据。

b13e21dfc353.en: Chapter nine. The House's forty-second rule belongs to its research desk and its market makers, with compliance watching. A learned agent is evaluated not only in the market it was trained on, but in the market its own success would create.
b13e21dfc353.zh: 第9章。本系列公司的第42条规则属于它的研究部门和做市商，由合规部门监督。一个学习型智能体不仅要在它受训的市场里评估，还要在它自己的成功会创造的市场里评估。

adf314cb9fd2.en: What these experiments contribute. <bookmark mark='a'/> The hard-market learner scores about 89, against 113 for the best tested fixed rule. One training run cannot isolate a regime effect. <bookmark mark='b'/> With independent unit-variance components, common coefficient point two gives 86 percent of aggregate flow variance. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pricing policies show supra-competitive prices and conditional retaliation. <bookmark mark='d'/> Fixed-fill replay exaggerates the illustrated wider-quote score. <bookmark mark='e'/> These are research diagnostics. They do not constitute a completed deployment approval process.
adf314cb9fd2.zh: 这些实验提供什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>困难市场学习者得分约89，最好测试固定规则为113。一次训练无法隔离环境效应。<bookmark mark='b'/>独立单位方差分量下，共同系数点二贡献总订单流方差的86%。<bookmark mark='c'/>定价策略出现超竞争价格与条件报复。<bookmark mark='d'/>固定成交回放夸大了示例宽报价的得分。<bookmark mark='e'/>这些是研究诊断，不构成已完成的部署批准流程。

078cc40be038.en: A proposed coordination stress test. <bookmark mark='a'/> Train against copies across seeds and inspect frozen-policy behaviour, allowing for cycles and incomplete recurrence searches. <bookmark mark='b'/> Force a one-period deviation. <bookmark mark='c'/> Inspect individual responses as well as their average. <bookmark mark='d'/> Retaliation and recovery trigger further analysis of profitable deviations, information exchange and applicable law. This procedure is a diagnostic, not proof that a learned policy is an equilibrium or a legally prohibited agreement.
078cc40be038.zh: 一项建议的协调压力测试。<bookmark mark='a'/>跨种子与复制品训练，检查冻结策略，考虑循环与不完整的重复状态搜索。<bookmark mark='b'/>强迫一期偏离。<bookmark mark='c'/>既看平均响应，也看个体响应。<bookmark mark='d'/>报复与恢复应引发对有利偏离、信息交换及适用法律的进一步分析。这是诊断，不证明策略是均衡，也不证明存在法律禁止的协议。

159eed37aea8.en: Proposed governance around the experiments. <bookmark mark='a'/> Independent limits and a human-controlled stop mechanism should sit outside the learned policy. <bookmark mark='b'/> Review shared data, objectives and providers for common exposures; diversity alone is not a guarantee of stability. <bookmark mark='c'/> A real prospective study should record configurations, seeds and retraining before evaluation. This part describes that standard without creating or opening a strategy trial registry.
159eed37aea8.zh: 围绕实验的建议治理。<bookmark mark='a'/>独立限额与人工控制的停止机制，应位于学习策略之外。<bookmark mark='b'/>审查共享数据、目标与供应商带来的共同敞口；多样性本身不保证稳定。<bookmark mark='c'/>真实的前瞻研究，应在评估前记录配置、种子与重新训练。本部分只描述标准，不创建或打开策略试验登记簿。

2b8e934e5606.en: And the agent registry. <bookmark mark='a'/> An agent is its code, its data, its seed and the version of the simulator it learned in: enough to rebuild it exactly. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each retraining makes a new agent, and a new trial on the House's counter. <bookmark mark='c'/> And approval means the four tests, re-run on every new agent. An agent that passed last month and has retrained since has not passed.
2b8e934e5606.zh: 以及智能体登记簿。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个智能体就是它的代码、数据、随机种子，以及它学习时所用模拟器的版本：足以精确重建它。<bookmark mark='b'/>每次重训产生一个新的智能体，也是本系列公司计数器上的一次新试验。<bookmark mark='c'/>批准意味着对每个新智能体重新运行四项检验。上个月通过、之后又重训过的智能体，不算通过。

81e8caf9326c.en: The House's code for Chapter six. After both firms choose, the new state is the pair of prices. Each firm takes its profit, adds the discounted value of the best price in the new state, and moves its table entry a step toward that target. Nothing in it mentions a rival's intentions, or collusion.
81e8caf9326c.zh: 本系列公司第6章的代码。两家公司都选择之后，新状态就是这对价格。每家公司拿到自己的利润，加上新状态下最好价格的折现价值，并把表中的条目向这个目标移动一步。其中没有任何地方提到对手的意图，也没有提到合谋。

9ee281a82314.en: And the audit. Force firm one to its best response to firm two's price for one period, then let both play their learned strategies and record the prices that follow.
9ee281a82314.zh: 以及审计。强迫一号公司在一期内对二号公司的价格作出最优反应，然后让两者按学到的策略行动，并记录随后的价格。

e0dc117b3cf5.en: The tools this part adds, in the House's agents module. <bookmark mark='a'/> Artificial markets and herding; a dealer market and its learner; collusion and monoculture. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the forty-second rule. A learned agent trades only after it has been tested in markets it never trained in, against copies of itself, against a forced deviation, and live rather than replayed. And its limits sit outside it.
e0dc117b3cf5.zh: 这一部分在本系列公司agents模块中增加的工具。<bookmark mark='a'/>人工市场与羊群效应；交易商市场及其学习者；合谋与单一化。<bookmark mark='b'/>以及第42条规则。一个学习型智能体只有在以下检验之后才能交易：在它从未受训的市场里，对抗它自己的副本，面对一次被迫的偏离，并且是实盘而不是回放。它的限额放在它之外。

a801f9d4d831.en: Three tests to carry away. <bookmark mark='a'/> When an agent did well in a simulator, ask what the simulator assumed about how others respond, and how the agent did in regimes it never saw. <bookmark mark='b'/> When prices stay high without an agreement, ask what happens after one seller cuts. <bookmark mark='c'/> And when many firms use one model, ask what share of the flow it drives, and what one mistake would do.
a801f9d4d831.zh: 三个随身带走的检验。<bookmark mark='a'/>当一个智能体在模拟器里表现很好，问模拟器对别人如何响应作了什么假设，以及这个智能体在它从未见过的状态里表现如何。<bookmark mark='b'/>当价格在没有协议的情况下居高不下，问一个卖家降价之后会发生什么。<bookmark mark='c'/>当许多公司使用同一个模型，问它驱动了多大份额的订单流，以及它的一个错误会造成什么。

27253388b2d7.en: For the researcher. We derive a grim-trigger incentive condition in an infinitely repeated, perfectly monitored game with common action domains and a credible static-Nash punishment. We then compare that continuous-game benchmark with finite-grid learning outcomes. The comparison does not certify the learners' equilibrium. A separate grid-restricted punishment calculation will be labelled as illustrative algebra rather than a general bound.
27253388b2d7.zh: 写给研究者。我们在无限重复、完美监测、动作域一致且静态纳什惩罚可信的博弈中，推导冷酷触发激励条件。然后将连续博弈基准与有限网格学习结果比较。这个比较不认证学习者的均衡。另一个限制在网格上的惩罚计算会明确标为示例代数，而非一般界。

b3d937e7dc3b.en: Three numbers from the one-period game. <bookmark mark='a'/> Pi c, each firm's profit when both charge a collusive price. <bookmark mark='b'/> Pi d, the most a firm can earn in one period by undercutting a rival who keeps that price. <bookmark mark='c'/> And pi n, the one-shot Nash profit. <bookmark mark='d'/> Undercutting pays today, colluding pays more than competing, and the game repeats forever with payoffs discounted by delta.
b3d937e7dc3b.zh: 单期博弈中的三个数。<bookmark mark='a'/>pi c，两家都收取合谋价格时每家的利润。<bookmark mark='b'/>pi d，对手维持该价格时，一家通过降价在一期内能赚到的最多利润。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及pi n，一次性纳什利润。<bookmark mark='d'/>降价今天有利，合谋比竞争有利，而博弈无限重复，收益按delta折现。

cf912079da1c.en: The tool. <bookmark mark='a'/> A strategy profile is subgame perfect if and only if no player can gain by deviating at a single history and then going back to the strategy. <bookmark mark='b'/> In discounted games with bounded payoffs, any profitable deviation can be cut short to a profitable one-shot deviation, because the far future counts for little. So it is enough to check one period at a time.
cf912079da1c.zh: 工具。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个策略组合是子博弈完美的，当且仅当没有参与者能通过在单个历史处偏离、然后回到原策略而获益。<bookmark mark='b'/>在收益有界的折现博弈中，任何有利的偏离都可以截短成一个有利的单次偏离，因为遥远的未来几乎不算数。所以一次检查一期就够了。

55b8b07e7613.en: The proof sketch. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose a deviation improves continuation payoff by epsilon at some history. <bookmark mark='b'/> With absolute stage payoffs bounded by M, truncation after T periods changes payoff by at most two M delta to the T over one minus delta. <bookmark mark='c'/> Choose T large enough to preserve a gain. <bookmark mark='d'/> If no one-shot deviation is profitable at any history, remove the last deviating date without lowering payoff, then work backwards through every earlier date. That contradicts the profitable finite deviation. This uses discounted bounded payoffs and the standard perfect-monitoring strategy framework.
55b8b07e7613.zh: 证明概要。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设某历史处的一项偏离改善延续收益至少艾普西龙。<bookmark mark='b'/>若各期收益绝对值不超过M，在T期后截断，收益变化至多为二M乘折扣因子的T次幂，再除以一减折扣因子。<bookmark mark='c'/>选择足够大的T，保留正收益。<bookmark mark='d'/>若任何历史处的单次偏离都不盈利，就可无损删除最后一个偏离日期，再逐期向前删除。这与有限偏离有利矛盾。论证依赖有界折扣收益与标准完美监测策略框架。

1ca2bfd3ab63.en: The theorem. <bookmark mark='a'/> The grim-trigger strategy, charge the collusive price as long as both always have, and the Nash price forever after any deviation, is a subgame-perfect equilibrium exactly when delta is at least pi d minus pi c, over pi d minus pi n. <bookmark mark='b'/> Patience must exceed the temptation to deviate, measured against the cost of the punishment.
1ca2bfd3ab63.zh: 定理。<bookmark mark='a'/>冷酷触发策略，即只要双方一直收取合谋价格就继续收取，一旦有任何偏离就永远收取纳什价格，是子博弈完美均衡，当且仅当delta至少为pi d减pi c，除以pi d减pi n。<bookmark mark='b'/>耐心必须超过偏离的诱惑，以惩罚的代价来衡量。

1b95d11117b0.en: The proof, by the lemma. <bookmark mark='a'/> Off the path, after a deviation, both charge the Nash price forever. That is subgame perfect: against a rival who will charge Nash whatever you do, no one-shot deviation pays. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the path, compare colluding forever with deviating once, earning pi d, and then Nash forever. <bookmark mark='c'/> Multiply through by one minus delta. <bookmark mark='d'/> And rearrange. Because pi d exceeds pi c, which exceeds pi n, the threshold lies strictly between zero and one.
1b95d11117b0.zh: 证明，借助引理。<bookmark mark='a'/>在路径之外，偏离之后双方永远收取纳什价格。这是子博弈完美的：面对一个无论你做什么都收取纳什价格的对手，任何单次偏离都无利可图。<bookmark mark='b'/>在路径上，比较永远合谋，与偏离一次赚取pi d、然后永远纳什。<bookmark mark='c'/>两边乘以一减delta。<bookmark mark='d'/>移项整理。因为pi d大于pi c，pi c又大于pi n，阈值严格位于零和一之间。

ca7c0869812b.en: A finite-punishment strategy needs its off-path rule specified. <bookmark mark='a'/> After deviation, play static Nash for T periods; any deviation during punishment restarts the clock. Then return to collusion. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the cooperation path, deterrence requires today's gain to be no larger than the discounted loss during T punishment periods. During punishment, Nash best response prevents a current gain and restarting delays the better continuation. <bookmark mark='c'/> A finite threshold below one exists only when T times the per-period punishment loss exceeds the deviation gain. Longer feasible punishments approach grim trigger.
ca7c0869812b.zh: 有限惩罚策略必须说明路径外规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>偏离后执行静态纳什T期；惩罚期再次偏离则重新计时，然后回到合作。<bookmark mark='b'/>合作路径上，当期偏离收益不得超过T期惩罚的折扣损失。惩罚期内，纳什最佳响应阻止当期获利，重新计时会推迟较好的延续。<bookmark mark='c'/>只有T倍每期惩罚损失严格大于偏离收益，才存在小于一的有限阈值。可行的更长惩罚趋近冷酷触发。

2744e8621629.en: Continuous-action logit benchmarks. <bookmark mark='a'/> These are the collusive, best-deviation and Nash profits for the stated action domain. <bookmark mark='b'/> The grim-trigger threshold is 0.39. <bookmark mark='c'/> A one-period Nash punishment requires 0.65; a five-period one requires 0.40, using the specified restart rule. <bookmark mark='d'/> The selected lower collusive prices give the displayed thresholds. The learners use fifteen prices, so their exact incentive constraints must be computed in that discrete game before claiming equilibrium.
2744e8621629.zh: 连续动作logit基准。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是指定动作域下的合作、最佳偏离与纳什利润。<bookmark mark='b'/>冷酷触发阈值为0.39。<bookmark mark='c'/>采用明确的重新计时规则，一期纳什惩罚要求0.65，五期要求0.40。<bookmark mark='d'/>选定的较低合作价格产生所示阈值。学习者只能选十五个价格；声称均衡前，必须在该离散博弈中计算精确激励约束。

20e97b22ef31.en: An important domain warning. <bookmark mark='a'/> The displayed minimisation takes a pure opponent price on the fifteen-point grid and a best response on that grid. It yields 0.204; this is not a mixed-action minmax calculation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Inserting that value alongside continuous-action monopoly and deviation profits gives the illustrative ratio 0.36. Because the action domains differ, it is not a universal lower bound or an established optimal penal code. <bookmark mark='c'/> The continuous grim reference is 0.39. Abreu's theory concerns credible continuation punishments under explicit game assumptions; this computation does not establish attainability of its illustrative ratio.
20e97b22ef31.zh: 一个重要的动作域提醒。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里在十五点网格上选择对手纯价格，并在同一网格求最佳响应，得到0.204；这不是混合动作最小最大值。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它与连续动作的垄断及偏离利润代入，得到示例比率0.36。动作域不一致，因此它不是普遍下界，也不是已建立的最优惩罚机制。<bookmark mark='c'/>连续冷酷触发参考值是0.39。阿布鲁理论研究明确博弈假设下可信的延续惩罚，本计算不证明这个示例比率可达到。

3a1a3bf57e0c.en: Comparing a theoretical reference with finite learning. <bookmark mark='a'/> The shaded region permits continuous-action monopoly under the specified grim strategy. <bookmark mark='b'/> At discount one half the learners' finite-run profit index is 0.21; higher tested discounts have larger averages. <bookmark mark='c'/> The grim threshold characterises that strategy, not every collusive equilibrium, and the learning game is discrete. These sessions do not prove a necessary patience threshold for learning. Exploration and coupled estimates are possible mechanisms, not identified causes from this chart alone.
3a1a3bf57e0c.zh: 理论参考与有限学习的比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>阴影区允许指定冷酷策略下的连续动作垄断。<bookmark mark='b'/>折扣二分之一时，学习者有限运行的利润指数为0.21；更高测试折扣有更大均值。<bookmark mark='c'/>冷酷阈值描述该策略，而非所有合谋均衡，学习博弈又是离散的。这些场次不证明学习所需耐心的必要阈值。探索与估计耦合只是可能机制，不能仅凭图表识别原因。

ce7be629e7a2.en: The mean learned impulse response returns near baseline after about 5 periods in the selected fixed-point subset. <bookmark mark='a'/> It is not a deterministic five-period Nash punishment. <bookmark mark='b'/> The theoretical five-period strategy has continuous-game threshold 0.40, below the learners' discount point nine five. <bookmark mark='c'/> Similar duration does not establish the learned policies' incentives at every history.
