Further deviations, individual responses and discrete action constraints need checking before an equilibrium claim.
ce7be629e7a2.zh: 选定固定点子样本的平均学习响应，约5期后回到基准附近。<bookmark mark='a'/>它并不是确定性的五期纳什惩罚。<bookmark mark='b'/>理论五期策略的连续博弈阈值为0.40，低于学习者的折扣点九五。<bookmark mark='c'/>持续时间相似，不等于每个历史处的激励相同。声称均衡前，还需检查进一步偏离、个体响应与离散动作限制。

e44467570d4a.en: Why learners find collusion at all. <bookmark mark='a'/> Not by reasoning about equilibria. A Q-learner's estimate of a price's value depends on what its rival is doing, so the two learners' errors move together. <bookmark mark='b'/> Martino Banchio and Giacomo Mantegazza call this spontaneous coupling, and show it can hold prices up even without memory or patience. <bookmark mark='c'/> And Sara Fish, Yannai Gonczarowski and Ran Shorrer report that pricing agents built on language models reach high prices in such games too.
e44467570d4a.zh: 学习者为什么会找到合谋。<bookmark mark='a'/>不是通过对均衡进行推理。Q学习者对一个价格价值的估计取决于对手在做什么，所以两个学习者的误差一起变动。<bookmark mark='b'/>马蒂诺·班基奥和贾科莫·曼特加扎称之为自发耦合，并证明它即使没有记忆或耐心也能维持高价。<bookmark mark='c'/>萨拉·菲什、亚奈·贡恰罗夫斯基和兰·肖雷尔报告，基于语言模型的定价智能体在这类博弈中也会达到高价。

5f82f19de21e.en: Related theory, with its assumptions kept visible. <bookmark mark='a'/> Folk theorems describe broad sets of feasible individually rational payoffs for sufficiently patient players under appropriate monitoring and game conditions; they do not select the outcome a learner reaches. <bookmark mark='b'/> Green and Porter show how imperfect monitoring can generate equilibrium price wars. Independent additive payoff noise here is only a loose analogy. <bookmark mark='c'/> Brown and MacKay analyse price algorithms and commitment through differing revision frequencies. High prices need not have the same mechanism in every algorithmic market.
5f82f19de21e.zh: 相关理论必须保留假设。<bookmark mark='a'/>民间定理在适当监测及博弈条件下，描述足够耐心参与者的广泛可行、个体理性收益集，不选择学习者最终到达哪个结果。<bookmark mark='b'/>格林与波特说明不完美监测如何产生均衡价格战。这里独立加性收益噪声只是一种宽松类比。<bookmark mark='c'/>布朗与麦凯分析定价算法及不同修改频率带来的承诺。不同算法市场的高价不必来自同一机制。

6b204bdcf206.en: Three open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> A theory of learning: which equilibria learners reach, how fast, and how that depends on exploration and memory. <bookmark mark='b'/> Detection: tests that distinguish learned collusion from competition in market data, without seeing the algorithms. <bookmark mark='c'/> And design: market rules that make learned collusion unprofitable.
6b204bdcf206.zh: 三个开放问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个学习理论：学习者会到达哪些均衡，多快，以及这如何取决于探索和记忆。<bookmark mark='b'/>检测：不看算法，就能在市场数据中区分学来的合谋与竞争的检验。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及设计：让学来的合谋无利可图的市场规则。

b95accde53c1.en: Pause and predict. With zero discounting, the grim-trigger mechanism cannot sustain a price with a profitable current deviation. Yet these finite-grid myopic learners can score above the continuous Nash reference. Give two possible explanations, and say why that does not prove a repeated-game equilibrium.
b95accde53c1.zh: 暂停并预测。折扣因子为零时，若当期偏离有利，冷酷触发机制不能维持该价格。但有限网格上的短视学习者仍可能高于连续纳什参考。给出两种可能解释，并说明为何这不证明重复博弈均衡。

a2b19adddc0c.en: Part forty-two in thirteen lines. Selected adaptive-agent models generate tails and clustered volatility; they do not identify a unique market mechanism. Kirman's chain has an exact beta-binomial stationary law. Matching historical moments does not validate intervention responses. In one partially observed dealer experiment, finite-trained learners trail the best tested fixed rule. And reusing fixed fills does not reproduce a new policy's interactive execution.
a2b19adddc0c.zh: 用十三条回顾第四十二部分。选定自适应智能体模型会产生厚尾与波动聚集，不识别唯一市场机制。柯曼链有精确贝塔二项平稳分布。匹配历史矩不验证干预响应。在一个部分可观测交易商实验中，有限训练学习者落后于测试过的最佳固定规则。沿用固定成交也不能复现新策略的交互执行。

b32679538904.en: No language-model trader was run here. Finite pricing experiments show supra-competitive profits and conditional retaliation, without certifying equilibrium or legal agreement. Common signals can dominate aggregate flow variance under explicit assumptions. Dated supervisory reports highlight concentration and correlation risks. The research chapter proves a specified grim-trigger condition and distinguishes it from mixed-domain illustrative calculations. Rule forty-two proposes testing agents against alternative markets and populations.
b32679538904.zh: 这里没有运行语言模型交易者。有限定价实验出现超竞争利润与条件报复，却不认证均衡或法律协议。明确假设下，共同信号可能主导总订单流方差。带日期的监管报告强调集中与相关风险。研究章证明指定冷酷触发条件，并与混合动作域的示例计算区分。第四十二条规则建议测试智能体面对其他市场与群体的表现。

c222c6679574.en: Three lessons. <bookmark mark='a'/> Market behaviour depends on agents, institutions and their interaction; matching a pattern is not unique causal identification. <bookmark mark='b'/> Learning can exploit reward definitions and simulator artefacts, so performance needs independent checks. <bookmark mark='c'/> Shared exposures can amplify shocks, while diversity may reduce alignment under suitable conditions. Neither learning nor diversity guarantees stability.
c222c6679574.zh: 三个启示。<bookmark mark='a'/>市场行为取决于智能体、制度及其交互；匹配一种图案不等于唯一因果识别。<bookmark mark='b'/>学习可能利用奖励定义和模拟器特点，因此表现需要独立检验。<bookmark mark='c'/>共同敞口能放大冲击，多样性在适当条件下可能减少同步。学习与多样性都不保证稳定。

aae88d370afc.en: The part on one card. The fundamentalist and chartist market. Kirman's exact law. The Q-learning update. The collusion thresholds, grim and finite. And the common share of a crowd's flow.
aae88d370afc.zh: 一张卡片上的这一部分。基本面交易者与图表交易者的市场。柯曼的精确定律。Q学习的更新。合谋的阈值，冷酷的和有限的。以及人群订单流的共同份额。

98cbdef0eee0.en: How this part connects. <bookmark mark='a'/> Backwards: volatility models, Q-learning, the trial counter, look-ahead, the market makers of Parts thirty-five to thirty-eight, and Part forty-one's herding. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sideways: collusion is spread competition with memory, and monoculture is common holdings made of models. <bookmark mark='c'/> Forwards: Part forty-three asks whether, in a market of such agents, anyone beats the market.
98cbdef0eee0.zh: 这一部分如何与其他部分相连。<bookmark mark='a'/>向后：波动率模型、Q学习、试验计数器、前视偏差、第35到38部分的做市商，以及第41部分的羊群效应。<bookmark mark='b'/>横向：合谋是带记忆的价差竞争，单一化是由模型构成的共同持仓。<bookmark mark='c'/>向前：第43部分追问，在由这样的智能体组成的市场里，是否有人能战胜市场。

61ad0571af43.en: Six desk questions. The hook asks whether wide spreads prove collusion. They do not. Retaliation is a diagnostic; equilibrium and legal conclusions require more evidence. <bookmark mark='a'/> Why is a tape not an interactive environment? New quotes change who fills them. <bookmark mark='b'/> What should simulator evaluation check? Responses to interventions, unfamiliar regimes, alternative opponents and assumptions behind the mapping to real trading.
61ad0571af43.zh: 六个交易台问题。宽价差能否证明合谋？不能。报复是一项诊断；均衡和法律结论需要更多证据。<bookmark mark='a'/>行情记录为何不是交互环境？新报价会改变谁来成交。<bookmark mark='b'/>如何评估模拟器训练的智能体？检查干预响应、陌生环境、其他对手，以及映射到真实交易所需的假设。

6ae6a304f167.en: How does herding cluster volatility? Through a slowly moving share of trend-followers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Why does a shared model matter? Its parts add coherently. <bookmark mark='b'/> And when can grim trigger hold the monopoly price? Above the threshold proved in the research chapter. Full solutions are in the notes.
6ae6a304f167.zh: 羊群效应如何让波动率聚集？通过一个缓慢变化的趋势追随者份额。<bookmark mark='a'/>共享模型为什么重要？它的部分相干地叠加。<bookmark mark='b'/>冷酷触发何时能维持垄断价格？高于研究者章节证明的阈值时。完整解答在讲义里。

b9955a895f8f.en: The research pause, answered. <bookmark mark='a'/> Discretisation changes the one-period game. Its listed equilibrium indices are -0.02 and 0.12, relative to continuous-action benchmarks. <bookmark mark='b'/> Finite learning need not reach either equilibrium: 89 percent of myopic sessions have reported indices above the higher listed grid equilibrium. Coupled learning estimates are one literature mechanism, but this statistic alone does not identify the cause or prove a repeated-game equilibrium.
b9955a895f8f.zh: 回答研究章的暂停问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>离散化改变单期博弈。列出的均衡指数为-0.02和0.12，相对于连续动作基准。<bookmark mark='b'/>有限学习不必到达任何一个均衡：89%的短视场次报告指数高于较高的网格均衡。耦合学习估计是文献中的一种机制，但这个统计本身不识别原因，也不证明重复博弈均衡。

b609a13528c8.en: And twelve problems: why size is predictable when returns are not; Kirman's alpha; its detailed balance; the best spread against elastic noise traders; the replay bias; the logit Nash price; collusion thresholds; the common share; a shared model's error; and collusion on a grid. Then two qualifying-exam problems: the one-shot deviation principle with its consequences, and Kirman's law in full. Solutions, in English and Chinese, are in the notes.
b609a13528c8.zh: 以及十二道习题：为什么收益不可预测而其大小可预测；柯曼的alpha；它的细致平衡；面对有弹性的噪声交易者时的最优价差；回放偏差；logit纳什价格；合谋阈值；共同份额；共享模型的错误；以及网格上的合谋。然后是两道资格考试题：单次偏离原则及其推论，以及完整的柯曼定律。中英文解答都在讲义里。

432396cdd813.en: Where this comes back. Part forty-three, the last, asks whether anyone beats a market made of agents like these, and why Andrew Lo called markets adaptive.
432396cdd813.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再次出现。最后的第43部分追问，在由这样的智能体组成的市场里，是否有人能战胜市场，以及罗闻全为什么称市场是适应性的。

985f88525e6c.en: The references separate reported historical episodes, published theoretical and simulation results, and this part's fixed-seed calculations. The only downloaded market series used here is Kenneth French's daily research-window data through twenty twenty. Source citations and the limits of the experiments are in the bilingual notes.
985f88525e6c.zh: 参考资料区分报道的历史事件、已发表理论与模拟结果，以及本部分固定种子的计算。这里唯一下载的市场序列，是肯尼斯·弗伦奇截至二〇二〇年的日频研究窗口数据。双语笔记列出来源与实验限制。

0651553a9789.en: The House's proposed rule is to test agents against markets and opponents their deployment could create. <bookmark mark='a'/> Next, Part forty-three asks whether anyone can beat the market: Sharpe's arithmetic, luck versus skill and the evidence required for a performance claim. This continuation makes no promise to open sealed strategy outcomes.
0651553a9789.zh: 本系列公司的建议规则，是在部署可能创造的市场与对手中测试智能体。<bookmark mark='a'/>下一部分，第四十三部分，讨论是否有人能战胜市场：夏普算术、运气与技能，以及表现主张需要的证据。这个后续内容不承诺打开封存策略结果。
